Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.
paper.title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?

paper.abstract: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. Analysis of agent trajectories reveal a shift in agent behaviour towards desirable patterns such as reduction in number of attempts to solve the task, improved task instruction following, debugging and testing.
paper.title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents

paper.abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.
paper.title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification

paper.abstract: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations. Higher exposure is associated with lower condition scores under a large language model (LLM) measure and AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE), with equal occupation weights and employment weights. Adjustment for physical demands, required education, training and experience, and wages reduces the composite association. The adjusted confidence intervals include zero for LLM exposure and remain below zero for AIOE. Separating repetition from restricted discretion also changes what the combined Dull score conveys. These comparisons show how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of exposure estimates. Occupational profiles offer a starting point for selecting contrasting research settings. Establishing desired automation or realized relief requires evidence about workers' preferences and specific interventions.
paper.title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure

paper.abstract: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.
paper.title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories

paper.abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.
paper.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents

paper.abstract: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
paper.title: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech

2611.08006.title_zh: 自动关键短语提取和注释：文本和语音的现代理论方法和实用解决方案

translation.abstract_zh: 文本和视听信息的指数级增长使得自动关键短语提取（KE）的任务变得越来越重要。本文全面分析了文本和语音模式中 KE 的当代理论方法和实际解决方案。这项工作的主要贡献是将这些通常不同的研究分支系统地综合成一个统一的分析框架，突出了该领域从统计方法到大型语言模型（LLM）和端到端语音处理的演变。我们研究了 KE 的阶段、书面和口语中关键短语的特征以及术语的细微差别。详细讨论和分析了自动 KE 的各种方法：统计方法、混合方法、基于机器学习的方法和结构方法。该评论重点关注新兴范例，包括使用法学硕士生成关键短语，并详细概述了自动语料库注释的方法和挑战。此外，我们还专门分析了口语 KE 的当前方向和固有困难，比较了基于转录的声学方法和端到端声学方法。这种综合使我们得出结论，该领域正在朝着更加集成、情境感知的范式发展。未来的进展将取决于解决关键挑战，例如低资源语言的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合以及生成 KE 系统的细致评估。
translation.title_zh: 自动关键短语提取和注释：文本和语音的现代理论方法和实用解决方案

paper.abstract: Nowadays, large language models produce text at scale, and much of it is redistributed across platforms. A moderator who finds a suspicious comment, post or article may want to know which platform generated it and for which account. In this paper we study attribution over the channel through which such text actually travels, copy-paste, which discards document metadata but keeps Unicode code points. We present KeHoSu, which turns the confusable characters of homoglyph attacks into a keyed attribution channel: the variant chosen for each carrier letter encodes one bit of an identifier made of a platform field, a user field and a truncated authentication tag. Moreover, given that reshared text is often quoted in fragments, and the placement therefore keeps no positional state, we show that KeHoSu is invariant to sentence reordering up to a constant boundary layer and depends on a partial quotation only through the retained length. We characterize the code-point channel by its capacity, removability and detectability, and provide an achievable region that relates the three. We evaluate KeHoSu over a wide range of use cases and show that the mark survived copy-paste across 18 common platforms, attributing the majority of all excerpts to the correct account at 178 letters (about two sentences) on LLM-generated stories and 167 letters (about one sentence) on standard English prose.
paper.title: KeHoSu: Keyed Homoglyph Substitution for Authenticated Text Provenance over Copy-Paste Channels

2611.08046.title_zh: KeHoSu：通过复制粘贴通道进行键控同形文字替换以验证文本来源

translation.abstract_zh: 如今，大型语言模型可以大规模生成文本，其中大部分文本可以跨平台重新分发。发现可疑评论、帖子或文章的版主可能想知道是哪个平台生成的以及哪个帐户生成的。在本文中，我们研究了此类文本实际传播的渠道（复制粘贴）的归因，该渠道会丢弃文档元数据但保留 Unicode 代码点。我们提出了 KeHoSu，它将同形文字攻击的易混淆字符转变为密钥归因通道：为每个载体字母选择的变体对由平台字段、用户字段和截断的身份验证标签组成的标识符的一位进行编码。此外，考虑到重新共享的文本经常在片段中被引用，因此放置不保持位置状态，我们表明 KeHoSu 对于句子重新排序在恒定边界层上是不变的，并且仅通过保留的长度依赖于部分引用。我们通过其容量、可移除性和可检测性来描述码点通道的特征，并提供将这三者联系起来的可实现区域。我们在广泛的用例中评估了 KeHoSu，结果表明该标记在 18 个常见平台上的复制粘贴中幸存下来，将所有摘录中的大部分归因于正确的描述，其中法学硕士生成的故事有 178 个字母（约两个句子），标准英语散文有 167 个字母（约一个句子）。
translation.title_zh: KeHoSu：通过复制粘贴通道进行键控同形文字替换以验证文本来源

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of neural networks directly, a capability termed weight-space programming. We ask whether the reading side of this capability reflects reasoning about weight flows or a combination of local arithmetic at the network's edges and memorized priors over public datasets. We test Claude Opus 5.5 on small convolutional networks of about 125,000 parameters trained on five image datasets, providing every weight as plain text with no tools, no forward passes, and no dataset or class names. The model performs accurate local calculations: batch-normalization statistics lead it to infer about three optimizer steps on networks stopped after three updates, and output-layer sign patterns recover the vehicle/animal split of CIFAR-10. The sessions report reading the first and last layers closely and sampling the middle, and several claims built on partial tracing fail verification, although we did not run a direct forward-pass test. Semantic judgments lean on familiar datasets: the model names CIFAR-10 for CIFAR-10 networks but also for all three fast-food networks, relabels KMNIST as MNIST, reads a 99.57%-accurate SAT-6 network as CIFAR-10 animal photos, and calls "frog" the output favored by a feature that fires most on trees. Permuting CIFAR-10's labels preserves the output split at the new indices, but every class pair the model interprets is then wrong, indicating reliance on remembered label order. These are exploratory results from mostly single runs. We conclude that zero-shot weight reading by this model is better described as local arithmetic plus dataset priors than as weight-flow tracing, and we provide a protocol for auditing future weight-space claims.
paper.title: Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"

2611.08070.title_zh: 法学硕士实际上可以对神经网络的权重进行推理和编程，还是只是加强记忆？探索“权重空间规划”

translation.abstract_zh: 最近有报道称，大型语言模型（LLM）可以直接读取和写入神经网络的原始权重，这种能力称为权重空间编程。我们询问此功能的读取方面是否反映了对权重流的推理或网络边缘的本地算术与公共数据集上记忆的先验的组合。我们在五个图像数据集上训练的约 125,000 个参数的小型卷积网络上测试 Claude Opus 5.5，以纯文本形式提供每个权重，无需工具、无需前向传递，也无需数据集或类名称。该模型执行准确的本地计算：批量归一化统计数据使其能够推断出在三次更新后停止的网络上的大约三个优化器步骤，并且输出层符号模式恢复了 CIFAR-10 的车辆/动物分裂。会话报告仔细读取第一层和最后一层并对中间进行采样，尽管我们没有运行直接的前向测试，但基于部分跟踪构建的一些声明未能通过验证。语义判断依赖于熟悉的数据集：模型将 CIFAR-10 网络命名为 CIFAR-10，同时也将所有三个快餐网络命名为 CIFAR-10，将 KMNIST 重新标记为 MNIST，将 99.57% 准确度的 SAT-6 网络读取为 CIFAR-10 动物照片，并将最喜欢在​​树上触发的特征称为“青蛙”输出。排列 CIFAR-10 的标签会保留新索引处的输出分割，但模型解释的每个类对都是错误的，表明依赖于记住的标签顺序。这些是大多数单次运行的探索性结果。我们得出的结论是，该模型的零样本权重读取更好地描述为局部算术加数据集先验，而不是权重流跟踪，并且我们提供了用于审核未来权重空间声明的协议。
translation.title_zh: 法学硕士实际上可以对神经网络的权重进行推理和编程，还是只是加强记忆？探索“权重空间规划”

paper.abstract: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. The code will be made publicly available.
paper.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics-Aware Industrial Anomaly Detection and Reasoning

2611.08080.title_zh: 时空动态感知工业异常检测与推理

translation.abstract_zh: 工业异常检测（IAD）是一个长期存在的问题，旨在检测制造过程中工业产品的缺陷以进行质量控制。大多数现有研究侧重于静态视觉模式作为检测的基础。然而，在真实的制造环境中，许多异常都是基于动态的，例如仅通过静态线索无法感知的不规则运动。我们观察到，由于时间建模能力有限，即使是最近基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法也无法识别此类动态异常。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 MUSTARD：多模态时空异常推理和检测，这是一个为 MLLM 配备细粒度时空动态感知的框架，用于检测和推理基于动态的缺陷。 MUSTARD 引入了光流引导关键帧选择和增强模式，通过局部运动模式和全局动态演化来捕获关键运动不规则性。其正常的基于模式的推理管道仅需要少量正常的参考样本作为检测基础，避免任何模型更新。这使得能够有效地适应各种产品并提供高度的决策可解释性。 MUSTARD 是第一个基于 MLLM 的基于动力学的 IAD 框架。实验证明其在检测时空异常和提供合理解释方面具有卓越的性能。该代码将公开。
translation.title_zh: 时空动态感知工业异常检测与推理

paper.abstract: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices requires balancing performance with compute and memory constraints. Post-training compression is an effective approach to managing this trade-off, while requiring much less computation than in-training counterparts. We propose DictLLM, a dictionary-based compression scheme in which weight matrices within grouped layers are decomposed into a shared dictionary and layer-specific sparse coefficients, directly obtained from a pre-trained model without further training. Specifically, we cast DictLLM as a four-step post-training optimization. First, we obtain shared dictionaries via singular value decomposition (SVD) of input-scaled weight matrices, amortizing rank across grouped layers; second, we sparsify the layer-specific coefficients to the target compression ratio using a dictionary-aware Hessian; and third, we refine the dictionaries given the resulting sparse coefficients. Finally, we aggressively quantize both components using factor-specific Hessian information: input covariance for the dictionaries and the dictionary-aware Hessian for the coefficients. The resulting representation reduces memory footprint by storing a single shared dictionary per layer group, along with sparse layer-specific coefficients. On language modeling and zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, DictLLM consistently outperforms existing post-training low-rank compression methods and pushes the Pareto frontier between model size and performance. DictLLM compresses the original LLaMA-7B model by 5.1x with only a 2.9-point increase in WikiText-2 perplexity, achieving a 3.6x higher compression ratio than the state-of-the-art low-rank method.
paper.title: DictLLM: Post-training Compression of Large Language Model with Dictionary Kernels

2611.08082.title_zh: DictLLM：使用字典内核对大型语言模型进行训练后压缩

translation.abstract_zh: 在移动设备上高效部署大型语言模型 (LLM) 需要平衡性能与计算和内存限制。训练后压缩是管理这种权衡的有效方法，同时比训练中的压缩所需的计算量要少得多。我们提出了 DictLLM，一种基于字典的压缩方案，其中分组层内的权重矩阵被分解为共享字典和特定于层的稀疏系数，直接从预训练的模型中获得，无需进一步训练。具体来说，我们将 DictLLM 视为四步训练后优化。首先，我们通过输入缩放权重矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）获得共享字典，在分组层之间摊销排名；其次，我们使用字典感知的 Hessian 矩阵将特定于层的系数稀疏化为目标压缩比；第三，我们根据所得的稀疏系数来完善字典。最后，我们使用特定于因子的 Hessian 信息积极量化这两个分量：字典的输入协方差和系数的字典感知 Hessian 矩阵。由此产生的表示通过为每个层组存储一个共享字典以及稀疏的特定于层的系数来减少内存占用。在语言建模和零样本推理基准测试中，DictLLM 始终优于现有的训练后低秩压缩方法，并推动模型大小和性能之间的帕累托前沿。 DictLLM 将原始 LLaMA-7B 模型压缩了 5.1 倍，而 WikiText-2 困惑度仅增加了 2.9 点，实现了比最先进的低秩方法高 3.6 倍的压缩比。
translation.title_zh: DictLLM：使用字典内核对大型语言模型进行训练后压缩

paper.abstract: Human cognition organizes continuous experience into bounded units while maintaining continuity across them. Linguistic elements are also organized into bounded structural units such as words and phrases, with sentence marking the final bound of a grammatical construction process. How do such boundaries emerge? We propose boundaries emerge from interacting demands to maintain unresolved dependencies, integrate completed relations, and update semantic context, with structural completion allowing but not determining closure. First, in a generative simulation without predefined boundary positions or constituent labels, these demands produced sentence-like segment-length distributions and distinct characteristic timescales, with structural completion allowing but not determining closure. Near boundaries, unresolved dependency load declined, integration cost peaked, and accumulated pressure reset. Then, we tested whether same demands predicted human listeners' boundary choices during comprehension. Listeners were more likely to mark boundaries with fewer unresolved dependencies, higher integration cost and semantic mismatch, and elevated preceding memory load, beyond syntactic and prosodic cues. Third, in naturalistic self-paced reading, sentence-final slowing coincided with declining memory load and increasing integration cost and semantic mismatch, broadly consistent with the simulation. Processing same narratives with a large language model revealed increased local intrinsic dimensionality and straighter hidden-state trajectories at sentence endings, followed by larger representational updates. Boundary explained additional variation in reading time and hidden-state geometry beyond processing demands, but considerably less in next-token surprisal. Together, these findings suggest linguistic boundaries emerge as discrete manifestations of transitions in continuous processing dynamics.
paper.title: Linguistic boundaries emerge from pressure-constrained processing dynamics

2611.08085.title_zh: 语言边界源于压力受限的处理动态

translation.abstract_zh: 人类认知将连续的经验组织成有界的单元，同时保持它们之间的连续性。语言元素也被组织成有界的结构单元，例如单词和短语，句子标志着语法构建过程的最终界限。这样的界限是如何出现的？我们建议边界从交互需求中出现，以维护未解决的依赖关系，集成已完成的关系，并更新语义上下文，结构完成允许但不确定封闭。首先，在没有预定义边界位置或成分标签的生成模拟中，这些需求产生了类似句子的段长度分布和独特的特征时间尺度，结构完成允许但不确定闭合。在边界附近，未解决的依赖负载下降，集成成本达到顶峰，累积的压力重置。然后，我们测试了相同的要求是否可以预测人类听众在理解过程中的边界选择。听众更有可能通过更少的未解决的依赖关系、更高的集成成本和语义不匹配以及更高的先前记忆负载来标记边界，超越句法和韵律线索。第三，在自然主义的自定进度阅读中，句子最终减慢与记忆负载下降、集成成本增加和语义不匹配同时发生，与模拟大致一致。使用大型语言模型处理相同的叙述揭示了局部内在维度的增加和句子结尾处更直的隐藏状态轨迹，随后是更大的表征更新。边界解释了超出处理需求的读取时间和隐藏状态几何的额外变化，但下一个令牌的惊喜要少得多。总之，这些发现表明语言边界是作为连续处理动态转变的离散表现而出现的。
translation.title_zh: 语言边界源于压力受限的处理动态

paper.abstract: Production deployments often use different models to balance cost and quality through cascading, routing, and switching models during long conversations. Context accumulates across turns. Each switch requires the target to repeat prefill over this context. Existing methods transfer full-attention (FA) K/V caches across models. Hybrid linear-attention models also retain recurrent states (REC) and convolution histories (Conv). The interaction between Conv and REC complicates cross-model state transfer. Conv perturbations can change keys and values in recurrent layers and alter REC updates. Conv histories are overwritten, but changes in REC can still affect later outputs. More accurate REC reconstruction need not improve continuation. Building on this, we propose Hybrid State Transfer (HST) for all three state types. It uses structured REC maps and preserves history order during Conv alignment. We calibrate the adapters using the frozen target's outputs during continuation. FA cache map updates are merged offline. Across five benchmarks, Qwen3.5 4B$\rightarrow$27B and 9B$\rightarrow$27B achieve mean task retentions of 89.88% and 94.11%, respectively. With source caches already available, separate timing on synthetic 16K inputs yields handoff body speedups of $21.66\times$ and $21.91\times$.
paper.title: Beyond K/V Caches: Cross-Model State Handoff in Hybrid Linear-Attention LLMs

2611.08133.title_zh: 超越 K/V 缓存：混合线性注意力 LLM 中的跨模型状态切换

translation.abstract_zh: 生产部署通常使用不同的模型，通过长时间对话期间的级联、路由和交换模型来平衡成本和质量。上下文会在回合中累积。每个开关都要求目标在此上下文上重复预填充。现有方法跨模型传输全注意力 (FA) K/V 缓存。混合线性注意力模型还保留循环状态（REC）和卷积历史（Conv）。 Conv 和 REC 之间的交互使跨模型状态传输变得复杂。 Conv 扰动可以更改循环层中的键和值并改变 REC 更新。转换历史记录会被覆盖，但 REC 中的更改仍会影响以后的输出。更准确的 REC 重建不需要改善连续性。在此基础上，我们为所有三种状态类型提出混合状态转移（HST）。它使用结构化 REC 映射并在 Conv 对齐期间保留历史顺序。我们在继续过程中使用冻结目标的输出来校准适配器。 FA 缓存映射更新离线合并。在五个基准测试中，Qwen3.5 4B$\rightarrow$27B 和 9B$\rightarrow$27B 的平均任务保留率分别为 89.88% 和 94.11%。由于源缓存已经可用，合成 16K 输入上的单独计时可产生 $21.66\times$ 和 $21.91\times$ 的切换主体加速。
translation.title_zh: 超越 K/V 缓存：混合线性注意力 LLM 中的跨模型状态切换

paper.abstract: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.
paper.title: Describe Your Facial Expressions by Linking Image Encoders and Large Language Models

2611.08138.title_zh: 通过链接图像编码器和大型语言模型来描述您的面部表情

translation.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一项用自然语言描述面部图像的人类面部表情的新颖任务，该任务捕获了传统情感类别或面部动作单元（AU）之外的面部动作和情绪状态的细微差别。为了实现面部表情字幕模型，我们提出了一个三阶段训练框架，该框架使用合成的图像文本对和 BLIP-2 预训练技术来训练视觉到语言模型。为了克服面部表情字幕缺少训练图像-文本对的挑战，我们提出了一种策略，涉及使用 GPT-3.5 以及情感类别或 AU 的现有注释来合成和组合字幕。实验证明了我们的方法在生成描述面部动作和情绪细节以及它们之间的推理关系的标题方面的有效性，即使这些情绪不存在于训练数据中。研究还表明，视觉到语言任务增强了 AU 检测和情感分类任务中中间视觉特征的性能。
translation.title_zh: 通过链接图像编码器和大型语言模型来描述您的面部表情

paper.abstract: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.
paper.title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection

2611.08162.title_zh: RouteAlign：将任务要求与模型配置文件相结合以进行 LLM 服务选择

translation.abstract_zh: LLM 服务选择需要反映当前任务需求的绩效证据。总分掩盖了能力和难度的差异，而语义相关的示例可能涉及不同的技能组合。我们提出了 RouteAlign，它使用任务需求来构建模型性能的测量和服务的选择。任务需求描述了能力需求和难度，从而能够与相应的模型性能测量保持一致。历史要求决定了结果如何有助于全球概况和当地能力估计；传入的需求决定了这些测量如何为当前决策提供信息。共享评分器整合证据，发电成本偏好控制合格服务的选择。对不同任务和异构 LLM 服务的评估表明，RouteAlign 将经验质量成本边界扩展到更高的任务质量。与开放式 Jev 式决策后端的比较显示出一致的质量增益，并且生成成本比其最强的测试配置更低。消融支持本地性能证据的贡献，而目录更新实验证明了通过更新的模型测量有效重用拟合的评分器。
translation.title_zh: RouteAlign：将任务要求与模型配置文件相结合以进行 LLM 服务选择

paper.abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.
paper.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?

2611.08175.title_zh: PCBRouteAgent：LLM 代理距离成为 PCB 布线工程师还有多远​​？

translation.abstract_zh: 自动化印刷电路板 (PCB) 布线需要在严格的设计规则下协调板级连接决策与几何执行。尽管最近的代理可以与本机路由工具交互，但复杂电路板上的可靠路由仍然具有挑战性。我们推出了 PCBRouteAgent，这是一种多模式 PCB 路由代理，其灵感源自人类工程师如何协调全局策略与本地执行。全局布线规划器将电路板图像与结构化电气和几何信息相结合，以指定连接拓扑、布线顺序、走廊和层过渡。详细路由执行器通过 KiCad 的本机路由引擎实现这些指南并执行有界本地恢复。未解决的故障将作为结构化反馈返回，从而实现有针对性的指南修订，同时保留已接受的路线。我们在来自四个 PCBWorld-Bench 测试分组的 247 个合成和真实电路板上评估了 PCBRouteAgent。它在 D2、D3-A、D3-B 和 D3-C 上分别实现了 100%、94.9%、100% 和 40% 的干净通过率。在三个现实世界子集上，PCBRouteAgent 在干净通过率方面分别优于最佳评估基线 13.9、36 和 10 个百分点。
translation.title_zh: PCBRouteAgent：LLM 代理距离成为 PCB 布线工程师还有多远​​？

paper.abstract: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.
paper.title: SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving

2611.08196.title_zh: SMART：面向验证问题解决的基于状态的多智能体推理追踪

translation.abstract_zh: 对于上下文有限的复杂问题，例如主张，需要一种获取解决推理所需额外知识的手段。我们提出了一个多智能体框架 SMART，通过捕捉问题上下文中参与实体的隐含状态来获取知识。SMART 使用多种大型语言模型（LLM）和结构化的基于角色的提示策略，将状态知识整理为多样化、互补且对解决方案有意义的前提。利用来自这些经过实际验证的策划前提的知识，SMART 的知识引导解决推理在跨三个数据集的复杂科学主张的验证性能上提高了最多 20%。我们证明，将前提与现实世界知识相结合是必要的，并且可以将性能提高最多 5%。
translation.title_zh: SMART：面向验证问题解决的基于状态的多智能体推理追踪

paper.abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.
paper.title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs

2611.08216.title_zh: ProQuant：面向边缘MLLM的渐进量化感知训练

translation.abstract_zh: 具有出色感知和理解能力的多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）将推动一系列下游应用的发展。然而，它们巨大的计算和内存需求阻碍了在现实世界中的实施，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上。量化已成为部署大型模型的有效解决方案。虽然训练后量化（PTQ）在中等比特宽度下（例如 W8A8）能够成功保持性能，但在低比特量化（例如 W4A8）下会出现严重的性能下降，尤其是对于更适合边缘部署的小规模模型。在本文中，我们提出了 ProQuant，一种针对低比特 MLLMs 的新型权重-激活量化感知训练（QAT）框架。首先，为了将有限的微调数据集分布与预训练数据集分布对齐，我们提出了一种自重新标注（SRL）方案，用于重新采样开源多模态模型的响应数据集。其次，我们首次采用解耦视角来看待多模态（MM）理解和语言建模能力。我们提出了一种渐进式块激活（PBA）机制，以优先处理多模态理解恢复。我们还引入了视觉敏感因子$\vecτ$，有效识别MM关键层。涵盖2B-8B参数模型的多个基准测试的广泛实验表明，ProQuant显著优于现有方法。例如，我们的W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct平均准确率提升了6.6%，性能可与全精度对应者相当，性能下降仅约1%。代码可在 https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/ 获取。
translation.title_zh: ProQuant：面向边缘MLLM的渐进量化感知训练

paper.abstract: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R$^2$, a $\textbf{r}$eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for $\textbf{r}$ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R$^2$ grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced files. From 10k web-corpus candidates, Agent-R$^2$ distills 4k task instances that pair real multi-format attachments with fine-grained, deliverable-level rubrics. On this data, we train Agent-R$^2$-4B via supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving both end-to-end productivity performance and file-grounded reasoning. Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R$^2$-4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0$\%$ vs. 48.0$\%$) and OfficeQA (14.8$\%$ vs. 13.8$\%$). Further analysis shows that Agent-R$^2$ mitigates shortcut behavior, where agents produce superficially plausible deliverables before sufficiently grounding, constructing, or verifying them, while promoting sustained exploration.
paper.title: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis

2611.08219.title_zh: Agent-R$^2$：通过真实数据合成扩展代理以实现现实生产力工作

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在自主推理和工具使用方面取得了快速进展，这提高了人们对能够接管人类现实生产工作代理的期望。然而，目前的代理仍然难以完成此类任务，这些任务的成功需要遵循长期的专业工作流程、理解异构文件的上下文，并在细化的要求下生成可用的交付成果。一个关键瓶颈是缺乏可扩展的后训练数据，这些数据能够反映真实的工作意图、真实的文件环境以及可交付成果级别的评估。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了Agent-R$^2$，一个$	extbf{r}$eal-source数据合成框架，可以为$	extbf{r}$ealistic生产性工作扩展训练数据。Agent-R$^2$不依赖手工指定的工作流程或LLM生成的文件，而是通过整个流程在真实职业种子、语料库衍生的工作流程证据和真实网络来源文件上进行合成。从1万个网络语料候选中,Agent-R$^2$ 提炼了 4k 个任务实例，这些实例将真实的多格式附件与细粒度的可交付成果级评分标准配对。在这些数据上，我们通过监督微调和基于评分标准的强化学习训练了 Agent-R$^2$-4B，从而提升了端到端的生产力表现和基于文件的推理能力。仅在 4k 个实例上训练，Agent-R$^2$-4B 在 GDPval（51.0% 对 48.0%）和 OfficeQA（14.8% 对 13.8%）两项指标上均超越了 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507。进一步分析显示，Agent-R$^2$ 可以减轻捷径行为，即在充分建立、构建或验证可交付成果之前，代理生成表面上合理的成果，同时促进持续探索。
translation.title_zh: Agent-R$^2$：通过真实数据合成扩展代理以实现现实生产力工作

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for information access, content production, and agent-based task execution, but their outputs remain vulnerable to subtle, high-risk hallucinations. To systematically evaluate and advance post-generation hallucination detection, we introduce HaluCheck, a large-scale, bilingual benchmark comprising over 42k instances spanning both factual hallucinations in text and faithfulness hallucinations in agent trajectories. HaluCheck features fine-grained, multi-level annotations for detection, localization, and correction, covering different tasks and perturbation degrees. Experiments on fourteen LLMs reveal that, while models show basic sample-level detection ability, they struggle with fine-grained localization, correction, and agent hallucination detection. Further analysis demonstrates that thinking, web search, and supervised fine-tuning each offer partial improvements, but none fully solve the problem. HaluCheck thus provides a solid basis for benchmarking and diagnosing LLM reliability across text and agent scenarios.
paper.title: From Twisted Facts to Rogue Agents: Can LLMs Reliably Detect Multi-Dimensional Hallucinations?

2611.08231.title_zh: 从扭曲的事实到叛逆代理：大型语言模型能否可靠地检测多维幻觉？

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）广泛用于信息获取、内容生产和基于代理的任务执行，但其输出仍然容易受到微妙且高风险的幻觉影响。为了系统地评估和推进生成后幻觉的检测，我们引入了HaluCheck，这是一个大规模的双语基准，包含超过42,000个实例，涵盖文本中的事实性幻觉和代理轨迹中的真实性幻觉。HaluCheck提供了细粒度、多层次的注释，用于检测、定位和纠正，涵盖不同任务和扰动程度。在对十四个LLM进行的实验中显示，虽然模型表现出基本的样本级检测能力，但在细粒度定位、纠正以及代理幻觉检测方面表现不足。进一步分析表明，思考、网络搜索和监督微调各自提供了部分改进，但没有一种方法能完全解决问题。因此，HaluCheck为在文本和代理场景中对大型语言模型的可靠性进行基准测试和诊断。
translation.title_zh: 从扭曲的事实到叛逆代理：大型语言模型能否可靠地检测多维幻觉？

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often present synthesized answers without making their supporting evidence easy to inspect. We study how features of these answers relate to users' subsequent accepting, checking, and challenging in 489,283 assistant-user response pairs from ShareChat and WildChat. Broad attribution language appears in 31.9% of qualifying responses, compared with explicit URLs in 1.33%, revealing a gap between claims of grounding and preserved inspectable support. Attribution, uncertainty, and other response cues generally accompany both checking and challenging; only uncertainty shows a small statistically distinguishable pooled association favoring checking. Within Technical Help, uncertainty favors checking relative to challenging; refusals and reasoning traces favor challenging in Seeking Information. Scrutiny is concentrated in some conversations, while its apparent turn-to-turn persistence becomes much smaller when conversation-level differences and response ordering are examined separately. These results suggest that supporting verification requires attention to what evidence can be inspected, which question a user is trying to resolve, and the history of the interaction.
paper.title: Signals, Evidence, and Context: User Scrutiny in Real-World LLM Conversations

2611.08232.title_zh: 信号、证据与背景：现实世界大型语言模型对话中的用户审查

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常提供综合答案，但并未使其支持证据易于检查。我们研究了这些答案的特征如何与用户随后在 ShareChat 和 WildChat 的 489,283 个助手-用户响应对中的接受、核查和质疑行为相关。广义归因语言出现在 31.9% 的合格响应中，而明确的 URL 仅占 1.33%，显示了对来源声称与可检查支持之间的差距。归因、不确定性和其他响应提示通常伴随核查和质疑；只有不确定性显示出对核查略有显著的组合关联。在技术帮助中，不确定性相对于质疑倾向于核查；而在寻求信息中，拒绝和推理痕迹则倾向于质疑。审查集中在某些对话中，而其明显的逐轮持续性在考虑对话层级差异和响应顺序后则变得小得多。被单独检查。这些结果表明，支持验证需要关注可以检验哪些证据、用户试图解决哪个问题以及交互的历史。
translation.title_zh: 信号、证据与背景：现实世界大型语言模型对话中的用户审查

paper.abstract: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification---a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations---with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one, so a model must be close to many accepted answers; across seven multimodal entries (three seeds each) the strongest reach a multi-reference O-Eval of 64.58\%, while the \$2.54 open model holds 59.81\% at $1/100$ the cost. TB-MathModel turns the numeric core of modeling into a reproducible, machine-checkable signal for measuring long-horizon modeling competence and for collecting agent trajectories. The source code is available at https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.
paper.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling

2611.08237.title_zh: 终端风格数学建模平台：首个具有代理性和可验证性的数学建模基准

translation.abstract_zh: 数学建模将一个开放式的现实世界问题转化为假设、模型、解答和可辩护的建议，且其答案只有在既接近可信参考又在物理上可行时才有意义；现有的基准要么对求解器片段进行评分，要么用大语言模型评估报告，却没有对这些分数进行检验。我们引入了 TB-MathModel（终端风格数学建模基准），这是第一个将完整的竞赛风格建模问题同时实现智能化、可验证和终端化的基准，覆盖 18 个真实的 CUMCM 和 MCM 问题（2023–2025）。每个任务以容器化终端形式提供逐字陈述、官方附件和图表；智能体返回一个 JSON 工件，并根据最终问题中核心数值与杰出奖论文的复现结果进行评分。有两个设计选择使其与众不同：方向感知的单向评分，它从不惩罚超越参考值，以及两层可行性验证——程序化通过六种可判定的不变量形式和 624 个 Lean~4 义务---以及一个将不可行答案归零的硬门控。每个任务都是相对于多个人类优秀论文进行评分的，而不是仅针对一篇论文，所以模型必须接近许多被接受的答案；在七个多模态条目（每条目三个随机种子）中，最强的模型在多参考 O-Eval 上达到 64.58%，而 2.54 美元的开源模型以成本的 1/100 保持 59.81%。TB-MathModel 将建模的数值核心转化为可复现、可机器检查的信号，用于衡量长远建模能力以及收集智能体轨迹。源代码可在 https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling 获取。
translation.title_zh: 终端风格数学建模平台：首个具有代理性和可验证性的数学建模基准

paper.abstract: After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Three inputs from a blind GPT-5.6-luna writer that never saw the program reached 0.070. Two further frozen stages enlarged the menu to 1491 fragments and then added 233 hard distractors that match the legacy output on typical inputs. The edge input (0.058) and the frontier-model writer (0.058) passed their preregistered tests. Yet 0.168 and 0.153 of the hard wrong programs still passed. Two local-model writers failed their preregistered tests. Across four model families, the edge input cut wrong releases per attempt in all three open-weight families on all three menus, for example from 0.233 to 0.057, without lowering correct completion. Self-tests helped less. A blind AI audit flagged 34 contracts as stricter than their requirements. Dropping the disputed checks changed 0 verdicts, but class-label disputes remain open. No model-written code was executed. Artifacts are available from the authors on request.
paper.title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations

2611.08269.title_zh: 被接受但错误：API 迁移后大语言模型代码修复的无声失败

translation.abstract_zh: 在运行时或 API 迁移之后，一个由 LLM 修复的过程可以干净地运行，但仍返回错误结果，而对典型测试输入的发布检查却将其放行。我们报告了一项预注册研究，涵盖 CPython、Node.js 和 SQLite 中 60 个已记录更改的 73 个任务。每个候选程序都在实际运行时针对保留的契约执行。在整个修复空间中，对典型输入的全断言门释放了 0.410 的错误修复。一条从发行说明中编写的边缘输入将此降至 0.065，而在 15 个未见过的簇上则降至 0.061。三个由从未见过程序的盲写 GPT-5.6-luna 作家生成的输入达到了 0.070。两个进一步冻结的阶段将菜单扩大到 1491 个片段，然后添加了 233 个与典型输入上的旧输出匹配的难干扰项。边缘输入（0.058）和前沿模型作家（0.058）通过了其预注册测试。然而，0.168 和 0.153 的难错误程序仍然通过了测试。两个本地模型作家未能通过其预注册测试。在整个四个模型家族中，在所有三个开放权重家族的所有三个菜单上，每次尝试的边缘输入错误释放次数，例如从 0.233 降到 0.057，而不会降低正确完成率。自我测试帮助较小。一项盲AI审核标记了 34 个合同比其要求更严格。删除有争议的检查未改变任何判决，但类别标签争议仍未解决。没有执行任何模型编写的代码。文稿可根据作者要求提供。
translation.title_zh: 被接受但错误：API 迁移后大语言模型代码修复的无声失败

paper.abstract: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.
paper.title: A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing

2611.08284.title_zh: 情境完整性的生成模型：适当与不适当的信息共享

translation.abstract_zh: 情境完整性（CI）认为，适当的信息流取决于特定情境的规范。同样的披露在一种情境下可能是适当的，而在另一种情境下可能是不适当的。我们构建了一个情境完整性的生成模型，用于通过模拟对话研究信息共享。由大型语言模型扮演的两个角色交换信息，其中一个拥有私人信息，另一个寻求这些信息。我们考察了在不同情境下、信息持有者的决策逻辑、性格以及基础语言模型变化时，共享和拒绝行为的差异。当需要时，角色会与合法接收者共享信息，但也会向无权接收的人披露信息。该模型提供了一种研究披露和拒绝如何随对话的发展以及情境和角色变化而变化的方法。
translation.title_zh: 情境完整性的生成模型：适当与不适当的信息共享

paper.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.
paper.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression

2611.08290.title_zh: 自动压缩：自动化硬件指导的模型压缩

translation.abstract_zh: LLM剪枝必须在保持质量的同时，满足硬件和工作负载对延迟、吞吐量和内存的特定限制。现有的剪枝工作流程通常以参数数量为目标，要求从业者手动选择满足延迟、吞吐量和GPU内存限制的模型大小。然而，仅凭参数数量无法预测这些指标，这些指标取决于模型架构、工作负载、硬件和服务引擎。我们提出了AutoCompress，一种硬件指导的压缩框架，它将这些约束直接纳入可微架构搜索中。AutoCompress联合优化全局和每层结构，以生成异构架构，并通过经过端到端延迟、吞吐量和内存测量验证的服务引擎成本模型进行指导。我们在长上下文本地编码、批量数据中心服务以及延迟敏感的游戏内交互中评估了AutoCompress。与最先进的Minitron剪枝框架相比，AutoCompress 在八个基准测试中的平均准确率分别在 RTX 5070、RTX 5080 和 H100 上提高了 6.57、2.35 和 0.57 个百分点。AutoCompress 还将 Nemotron 3.5 Super 从 120B 参数压缩到 74B 参数，以便在 128K 上下文下进行单 B200 BF16 推理，同时保留其平均基准得分的 95%。
translation.title_zh: 自动压缩：自动化硬件指导的模型压缩

paper.abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.
paper.title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines

2611.08308.title_zh: RM-VLM：从自然语言任务描述到视觉归因奖励机

translation.abstract_zh: 奖励机器（RMs）已被提出作为强化学习（RL）中的一种奖励表达方式，以捕捉非马尔可夫任务，其中信用分配依赖于历史。通过将奖励函数表示为自动机，RMs 揭示了任务的时间结构，并允许在马尔可夫框架内处理这些奖励。然而，它们假设存在一个标注函数，即为观测提供命题基础的预言机，该函数必须针对每个环境手动设计，从而限制了其更广泛的适用性。在本工作中，我们通过提出 RM-VLM 来解决这一限制，该方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）从自然语言任务描述生成 RM，并使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为标注函数，在 RM 引导的策略学习过程中将 RM 的命题与基于图像的观测进行对应。基于 VLM 的价值函数估计器用于评估智能体在每个 RM 转换上的进展，并推导出密集奖励信号。我们评估RM-VLM 在三个领域中涵盖了非马尔可夫网格世界导航、机器人操作和三维物体收集。我们的实验结果表明，RM-VLM 在所有测试领域中始终比现有基于 VLM 的奖励方法实现更高的任务成功率。
translation.title_zh: RM-VLM：从自然语言任务描述到视觉归因奖励机

paper.abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
paper.title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification

2611.08311.title_zh: 用于基于EEG的睡眠分期分类的LLM辅助标签噪声校正

translation.abstract_zh: 从脑电图（EEG）信号自动分类睡眠阶段是临床睡眠医学中的关键任务。虽然深度学习模型在该领域显示出有前景的结果，但它们的性能从根本上受制于训练标签的质量，这些标签由人工专家手动标注，并且容易受到评分者之间的分歧和系统性标注错误的影响。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的标签噪声过滤管道，该管道仅在训练期间运行，用于在重新训练分类器之前识别和移除不可靠的睡眠阶段标注。具体来说，TinySleepNet首先在原始数据集上进行训练，以提取每个周期的SoftMax置信度分数，然后将低置信度周期连同其EEG频谱特征和周围序列上下文一起提交给LLaMA 3.1。LLM根据AASM睡眠评分指南评估每个周期，并给出可靠（RELIABLE）或可疑（SUSPICIOUS）的判定。可疑周期会被移除。从训练集中，TinySleepNet 在清理后的数据上重新训练。在使用 20 折交叉验证的 Sleep-EDF 扩展数据集上评估，我们的方法将整体准确率从 81.8% 提高到 84.6%，宏 F1 分数从 75.6% 提升到 77.4%，在 REM 检测方面尤为显著。关键是，由于大型语言模型仅在训练期间运行，轻量级的 TinySleepNet 架构（1.3M 参数）在推理时得以保留，使得所提出的方案适用于实时可穿戴睡眠监测应用。
translation.title_zh: 用于基于EEG的睡眠分期分类的LLM辅助标签噪声校正

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
paper.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation

2611.08315.title_zh: 在异构认知和生物医学知识图谱上对大型语言模型进行基准测试：图谱落地在多跳推理和幻觉缓解中的作用

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学和认知神经科学中被越来越广泛地使用，但其在异构知识图谱（KGs）上可靠推理的能力仍不清楚。我们在五个知识图谱（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map 和 GDPKG）上对五个LLMs（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen 和 BioGPT）进行了基准测试。我们引入了一个多层次查询数据集，用于评估在 KG 感知（基于图的）和 KG 不感知条件下的推理深度和事实准确性。评审员之间的一致性较高，Cohen 的 kappa 为 0.781（范围：0.753-0.807），Fleiss 的 kappa 为 0.77。结果显示，通用模型，尤其是 GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 2.0 Pro，在多跳和高级推理任务上通常优于领域特定模型，尽管随着查询复杂性的增加，性能有所下降。KG 基础减少了所有评估模型的虚构率。与我们最初的假设相反，领域特定模型并不始终在没有图形基础的情况下，在专业任务上表现优于通用模型。这些发现凸显了将广泛的语言模型能力与结构化领域知识相结合的价值。我们提供了基于任务复杂性和计算约束选择 LLM-KG 集成策略的实用指南，并讨论了用于个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断和可解释人工智能的混合神经符号架构。
translation.title_zh: 在异构认知和生物医学知识图谱上对大型语言模型进行基准测试：图谱落地在多跳推理和幻觉缓解中的作用

paper.abstract: Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.
paper.title: Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions

2611.08334.title_zh: 在反复社会互动中的文化适应

translation.abstract_zh: 人类文化的很大一部分是默会的，通常通过具体的社会互动来学习。随着大型语言模型（LLM）作为交互代理在不同社区中部署，评估它们的文化能力需要超越现有的问答方法，从关注它们知道什么转向关注它们如何适应。在这项工作中，我们通过研究大型语言模型是否可以通过沙盒环境中的重复互动进行适应，扩大了自然语言处理中文化适应的范围。通过将文化适应重新定义为通过社会互动进行规范同化的连续过程，我们的研究表明，记忆机制能够促进跨重复互动的长期学习，促进向不同社会环境的迁移，并实现五种语言的多语言规范同化。总体而言，我们的研究为大型语言模型中基于连续、互动驱动的文化适应奠定了基础。
translation.title_zh: 在反复社会互动中的文化适应

paper.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.
paper.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference

2611.08363.title_zh: StrataFlux：内存层次结构原生低位LLM推理

translation.abstract_zh: 量化可以减少大语言模型 (LLM) 推理的内存和带宽需求，但可能会降低准确性；将更高精度的数据卸载到其他地方反而可能会导致生成过程停滞。我们引入了 StrataFlux，这是一个通过恢复因低比特权重和键值 (KV) 缓存量化而损失的准确性，同时保留量化的内存和速度优势的框架。StrataFlux 共同设计了精炼表示、选择和传输，使主机 RAM 和固态硬盘成为有用的额外精度来源。其选择性精度流减少了传输量，将传输与计算重叠，并在解码步骤中重用已获取的精度，因此生成无需等待每次传输。我们在专用 GPU 和统一内存平台上评估了 2-4 位权重和 2-3 位 KV 缓存。在 2 位 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 权重下，StrataFlux 将 WikiText-2 的困惑度从 9.46 降低到 8.40，同时维持量化基线 95.4% 的吞吐量。RTX 5090。使用 2 位权重和 KV，StrataFlux 将 Qwen3-8B 在 AIME 2024/2025 的准确率从 11.0% 提升到 47.1%，而 GPU 内存使用量保持不变。在 128K 上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 使用 3 位权重和 2 位 KV，实现了与 vLLM 的 4 位 AWQ 权重和 8 位 KV 在 RTX 5090 上相当的困惑度和速度，同时仅使用大约一半的 GPU 内存。这些结果表明，驻 GPU 精度不必设定准确率上限，亦无需由卸载层延迟决定解码速度。
translation.title_zh: StrataFlux：内存层次结构原生低位LLM推理

paper.abstract: Federated learning servers combine client models with a fixed aggregation rule, and each rule in common use is designed for one kind of heterogeneity. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that inspects the client models can choose the rule itself, without any training on the server. In FedReason, the LLM is called every ten rounds. It analyses the weights by running code in a restricted server-side sandbox, sees only the printed results, may score a few candidates on a 500-image proxy set, and submits a short Python aggregation program. The server applies the program until the next call and falls back to FedAvg whenever its output is invalid. Full weight tensors never leave the server. We evaluated FedReason with Claude Opus 5.5 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 under Dirichlet label skew, width-heterogeneous sub-models and Byzantine clients, in 168 runs against 14 baselines. Across 12 paired label-skew runs it beat FedAvg by 1.26 percentage points on average (10 wins), and a control that spends the same per-round proxy budget on choosing among standard rules by 1.08 points. It was the strongest server-side rule on CIFAR-100 but did not beat SCAFFOLD, which changes client training. With three of ten clients malicious, it excluded all sign-flipping clients from the first round and stayed about one point below FLTrust without training a root model. Without proxy feedback, accuracy fell from 73.8% to 38.8% in one seed. A 60-round run cost 0.79 USD in API fees on average.
paper.title: FedReason: Large Language Models as Weight-Space Meta-Aggregators for Heterogeneous Federated Learning

2611.08383.title_zh: FedReason：大型语言模型作为异构联邦学习的权重空间元聚合器

translation.abstract_zh: 联邦学习服务器使用固定的聚合规则来合并客户端模型，每种常用规则都是为一种类型的异质性设计的。我们研究一个大型语言模型（LLM）是否可以在不进行服务器端训练的情况下，通过检查客户端模型自行选择规则。在FedReason中，LLM每十轮调用一次。它通过在受限的服务器端沙箱中运行代码来分析权重，只能看到打印的结果，可以在500张图像的代理集上对几个候选方案进行评分，并提交一个简短的Python聚合程序。服务器会应用该程序直到下一次调用，并在其输出无效时回退到FedAvg。完整的权重张量永远不会离开服务器。我们在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上使用Claude Opus 5.5对FedReason进行了评估，采用ResNet-18，在Dirichlet标签偏斜、宽度异质子模型和拜占庭客户端的情况下进行，168次运行对比14个基线。在12次成对标签偏斜的运行中，它平均比FedAvg高1.26个百分点（10次胜利）一个控制组在每轮代理预算上选择标准规则时得分高出1.08分。它是在CIFAR-100上最强的服务器端规则，但没有超过SCAFFOLD，后者会更改客户端训练。在十个客户端中有三个恶意客户端的情况下，它在第一轮就排除了所有符号翻转的客户端，并且在没有训练根模型的情况下，其表现大约比FLTrust低一个点。如果没有代理反馈，准确率在一个随机种子下从73.8%下降到38.8%。一次60轮的运行平均在API费用上花费0.79美元。
translation.title_zh: FedReason：大型语言模型作为异构联邦学习的权重空间元聚合器

paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control, but inference is increasingly expensive. Each decision processes hundreds of visual tokens, often across multiple cameras, leading to substantial computation while allowing irrelevant background content to distract action prediction under distribution shift. We argue that these issues stem from two complementary forms of redundancy: many visual tokens are spatially irrelevant, while attention over the remaining tokens is often misallocated. Based on this observation, we propose T3R, a Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement framework. In the first stage, segmentation-guided token pruning removes irrelevant visual patches to reduce computation and eliminate distracting context. In the second stage, saliency-guided attention biasing reallocates attention toward action-critical visual regions and language instructions within the retained tokens. Together, pruning produces a cleaner candidate set, while attention biasing further emphasizes the most decision-relevant evidence, yielding a better accuracy-efficiency frontier than either stage alone. On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate, and improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations. The timing comparison attributes 7.8 ms per inference call to pruning and attention-bias application. As input resolution increases, LLM-forward profiling shows up to a 3.3x speedup over the unpruned baseline. Evaluations across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and RoboTwin with three VLA backbones show the strongest accuracy-efficiency benefits in multi-camera settings. These results demonstrate that training-free token refinement is a practical approach to efficient and robust VLA inference.
paper.title: T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models

2611.08413.title_zh: T3R：无需训练的两阶段令牌优化，迈向高效且稳健的VLA模型

translation.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型实现了端到端的机器人控制，但推理成本越来越高。每个决策需要处理数百个视觉令牌，通常来自多个摄像头，这导致了大量计算，同时在分布变化下允许无关的背景内容干扰动作预测。我们认为这些问题源于两种互补的冗余形式：许多视觉令牌在空间上是无关的，而对剩余令牌的注意力往往分配不当。基于这一观察，我们提出了T3R，一种无需训练的两阶段令牌优化框架。在第一阶段，基于分割的令牌剪枝去除无关的视觉区域，以减少计算量并消除干扰性背景。在第二阶段，基于显著性的注意力偏置将注意力重新分配到保留令牌中的动作关键视觉区域和语言指令。结合起来，剪枝产生了更干净的候选集合，而注意力偏置进一步强调最与决策相关的证据，从而比单独的任何阶段获得更好的准确性-效率前沿。在 LIBERO-Spatial 上，T3R 移除了 85% 的场景-相机视觉标记，同时基本上匹配未剪枝的成功率，并在分布外对象放置扰动下将成功率提高多达 7 个百分点。时间比较显示，每次推理调用中有 7.8 毫秒用于剪枝和注意力偏置应用。随着输入分辨率的增加，LLM 前向分析显示相比未剪枝基线最高可加速 3.3 倍。在使用三种 VLA 骨干网络的 LIBERO、SIMPLER 和 RoboTwin 评估中，多摄像头场景下表现出最强的准确性-效率优势。这些结果表明，无需训练的标记优化是一种实现高效且稳健的 VLA 推理的实用方法。
translation.title_zh: T3R：无需训练的两阶段令牌优化，迈向高效且稳健的VLA模型

paper.abstract:
Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958).
  We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves.
  More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.
paper.title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks

2611.08417.title_zh: 作为软件的基准：Terminal-Bench 及持续基准的案例

translation.abstract_zh:
编码代理是迄今为止大型语言模型（LLM）应用中经济影响最显著的之一，因此可靠的评估变得越来越重要。然而，即使是在发布时经过仔细验证的基准测试也可能变得过时。随着模型的改进，它们可能会发现现有验证器拒绝的有效解决方案，而评估基础设施的变化可能会使任务和测试中嵌入的假设失效。我们将由此产生的缺陷积累称为基准维护债务：基准分数与其旨在衡量的能力之间日益扩大的差距。我们引入了一种连续验证的代理基准工作流程，该流程结合了社区报告、任务工件、代理轨迹、自动化参考检查和人工把关的修复。我们将此工作流程应用于 Terminal-Bench 2.0，这是一项在发布前经过广泛人工和语言模型辅助审查及红队测试的基准。我们的审计在大约 30% 的基准中发现了问题，并将由此产生的修复结果发布为Terminal-Bench 2.1。这些修复改变了评估结果：准确率提高了超过10个百分点，排行榜位置最多变化三名，即使整体排名仍然高度相关（Spearman rho = 0.958）。
我们评估了资源分配如何影响基准结论。我们展示了固定的实际运行时间会显著改变代理性能：例如，延长时间限制可以缩小GPT 5.4上20个百分点的差距，并将GPT 5.4 mini上30个百分点的差距缩小到5个百分点。因此，基准维护不仅仅是修复任务工件：资源预算是测量规范的一部分，必须与任务本身一起进行验证。
更广泛地说，基准维护债务不仅仅是积累的实现错误：我们的结果显示，随着模型的改进，评估假设和资源设置都可能需要重新验证。
translation.title_zh: 作为软件的基准：Terminal-Bench 及持续基准的案例

paper.abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.
paper.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI

2611.08428.title_zh: 未来软件中元访问的力量——在大型语言模型聊天界面和聊天人工智能上的演示

translation.abstract_zh: 聊天仍然是许多大语言模型（LLM）任务的默认界面，即使像 OpenCode 这样的自主工具在编码和自动化方面表现出色。然而，模型只能看到当前的对话，而看不到周围的工作空间。我们探讨了元访问——为助手提供一个结构化、具有权限的界面视图，并提出了一个分级体系：功能辅导；元数据、设置和偏好访问；对摘要和消息的检索、确认变更，以及完整的编排。元访问可以将聊天客户端从多个屏幕转变为查找、导航、组织和操作的单一入口，同时也带来了关于依据、隐私、提示注入和信任的风险。通用自主代理的运行时因为可以更改自身设置，元访问变得自反，需要一个独立的控制平面边界。我们以 Chat AI 客户端的 Meta Chat 原型为基础。它通过例如摘要、设置等构建了有限的上下文相关消息；链接参考对话、主题和角色；支持已确认的、可逆的更改；提供可浏览的教程库；并推荐作为用户发起对话的角色。通过以结构化形式公开应用程序状态，元访问可以将屏幕阅读器的功能从小部件描述扩展到语义工作区操作。因此，元访问将聊天从仅限一个对话的窗口转变为整个工作区的控制层，将聊天扩展为具备代理能力的功能，同时不放弃用户控制。随着助手嵌入到 IDE、仪表板、办公套件和操作系统中，AI 时代的界面应公开其状态和能力的结构化、受权限控制的模型，理想情况下通过类似调试器的界面开放其现有的元模型。
translation.title_zh: 未来软件中元访问的力量——在大型语言模型聊天界面和聊天人工智能上的演示

paper.abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
paper.title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue

2611.08433.title_zh: MedGraph：通过图记忆维护患者状态以进行长期医疗对话

translation.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗助理在跨次就诊中跟踪患者时，需要一种能够随着患者临床状态变化而保持其正确性的记忆。我们检视了五种记忆系统在纵向医疗对话中的错误，并发现三种常见原因：检索到的证据提供了过时的状态、包含了他人的健康信息，或者缺少答案所依赖的安全信息。我们提出了 MedGraph，一种针对这三种情况构建的图形记忆。其构建过程从每次就诊中提取过时的事实，将每条事实归属到描述的个人，并将用药、诊断和测量记录链接成链条，以保留先前的状态。检索时，将患者的链条作为整体进行排序，在提问的时间点读取每条链条，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案列出了每个问题涉及的每条记录的安全信息。在 MedMemoryBench 测试中，MedGraph 在拥有 GPT 和 Qwen 两种骨干模型时，都取得了最高的整体准确率，比表现最强的系统分别高出 10.5 和 10.4 个百分点。五个基线，在 GPT 设置中具有高效的记忆构建和回答能力。
translation.title_zh: MedGraph：通过图记忆维护患者状态以进行长期医疗对话

paper.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
paper.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization

2611.08483.title_zh: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现和优化的潜在智能体群

translation.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）指导的进化搜索通过迭代优化解决方案并结合高评分的方法，使用 AI 代理来改进数学和计算问题的程序。然而，这个过程通常很慢，因为 LLM 在每一轮都生成长文本的思维链，并且必须多次重复这种生成以维持群体的多样性。我们提出了 SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮有数百个低成本代理组成的蜂群，它们在潜在空间中进行推理而不解码为文本，并通过传递 KV 缓存来共享信息。每个蜂群从不同的角度研究问题。新颖性过滤器通过直接测量代理隐藏状态向量之间的距离来保留最独特的代理想法。想法的交叉在潜在空间中自然发生，因为一个汇总代理接收所有蜂群成员的 KV 缓存组合。在数学发现和科学计算的 21 个问题上，SwarmEvolve 获得了最高的平均分，并且需要的仅需 3 到 8 分钟的中位时间即可达到其他最先进框架在 60 分钟内才能达到的最佳分数。在多个问题上，SwarmEvolve 搭配 Qwen3 8B 改进了 AlphaEvolve 使用前沿 LLM 首次找到的解决方案。我们的工作表明，在潜在空间中交流的智能体群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。
translation.title_zh: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现和优化的潜在智能体群

paper.abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.
paper.title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation

2611.09785.title_zh: 这些程序员成熟到可以食用了吗？评估大型语言模型如何处理翻译中的词汇知识冲突

translation.abstract_zh: 外部词汇资源可以帮助大型语言模型（LLMs）翻译低资源语言和专业领域的文本，但这些资源可能与模型已有的词汇知识发生冲突。为了孤立这种冲突，我们构建了一个受控的中文到英文翻译任务，在该任务中，熟悉的源词在语义类别内和跨语义类别被赋予新的含义。我们将这些提示提供的含义视为上下文知识（CK），并系统地评估词频、句子上下文和提示框架对翻译输出的影响。在九个模型中，对于低频源词以及支持所提供含义的句子上下文，CK的依赖性更高。提示框架可以减少CK依赖，但在九个模型中有七个模型即使被明确指示忽略所提供的含义，也倾向于依赖CK。在模型家族内部，较大的模型比较小的模型更可能在输出中利用CK。三项后续实验进一步表明模态削弱降低了对CK的依赖，重复的效果取决于提示布局，而推理的效果在不同模型之间有所不同。总体而言，我们的受控研究揭示了在不同条件和模型下CK依赖的变化，从而促使开发新的方法来检测和评估词汇冲突，并指导模型在基于大语言模型的翻译中的词汇选择。
translation.title_zh: 这些程序员成熟到可以食用了吗？评估大型语言模型如何处理翻译中的词汇知识冲突

paper.abstract: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.
paper.title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving

2611.09791.title_zh: 评估检索增强生成对算法问题解决的影响

translation.abstract_zh: 竞争性编程问题对大型语言模型提出了独特的挑战，因为它们不仅要求熟练的代码生成能力，还要求高级的算法推理能力。本研究提出了一种检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）方法，专门用于提升大型语言模型解决此类问题的能力。我们的方法集成了基于嵌入的检索机制和相似性搜索算法，以在知识数据库中识别类似问题，并采用动态调整的阈值来减轻检索噪声。我们使用 CodeContests 数据集进行评估，重点关注与训练集实例相似的测试集问题。实验框架考虑了三种情况：(i) 仅提供问题的原始描述，(ii) 问题附加来自训练集的随机选取的示例，以及 (iii) 问题通过检索获得的类似示例进行增强所提出的方法。此外，我们还加入了 Min-K 成员推断分析，以检查生成的代码解决方案是否受到评估的大型语言模型中训练数据潜在记忆的影响。这一补充视角通过区分通过检索实现的真实泛化与对预训练样本的隐式回忆，使对模型行为的理解更加深入。性能评估通过通过率和问题的 CodeForces Elo 评分进行。结果提供了实证证据，表明基于相似性的检索显著提升了大型语言模型在竞赛编程场景中的表现，为在算法问题求解背景下改进代码生成提供了可扩展的框架。
translation.title_zh: 评估检索增强生成对算法问题解决的影响

paper.abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.
paper.title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents

2611.09802.title_zh: 当指令文件过时：编码代理中的文档债务与隐藏成本

translation.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码代理，例如 Claude Code，受到仓库指令文件（也称为上下文文件或代理配置文件）的指导，如 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md，这些文件会在每次代理会话中被读取。像任何文档工件一样，这些文件可能会落后于代码而变得过时（例如，一个测试文件夹移动了，但文件仍指向旧的路径）。从技术债务的角度来看，这种过时的指令就是文档债务，其利息是它给每次后续代理会话增加的成本。只检查任务成功与否的评估可能会忽略这一成本，而且过时的文件可能会持续存在。在这项研究中，我们探讨导致代理执行过时指令的原因、它如何影响代理行为及其成本，以及代理如何恢复。我们深入研究了三个真实世界中来自活跃开源仓库的过时指令，每个指令都是不同类型的指导：一个测试命令、一个代码位置和添加组件的流程。在三种版本下，代理修复了 22 个维护任务每条指令（保持过时状态、改正到当前路径并删除），在代码和任务保持不变的情况下，我们分析了两个模型在单个工具调用层面的 732 条轨迹。我们发现，当过时的指导与任务相关时，代理会遵循它，有时即使其他地方有正确信息也会如此。在过时的测试命令上，Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次运行大约需要额外两次工具调用，比使用更正后的命令多三分之一；在其他情况下，我们未能检测到差异。虽然代理通常能从即时失败中恢复，但没有一个修复了底层的指令文件。纠正指令消除了对过时路径的操作，而删除指令则防止了大部分操作。我们的研究表明，仅凭任务成功可能掩盖文档债务的成本，这凸显了评估代理行为不仅要看最终结果的必要性。
translation.title_zh: 当指令文件过时：编码代理中的文档债务与隐藏成本

paper.abstract: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option.
