We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.
paper.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model

2611.09803.title_zh: Maya a1：选项是读取模型，还是它们的位置？非自回归决策模型中的顺序敏感性

translation.abstract_zh: Laya 通过在每个选项的一个 [MASK] 标记处对隐藏状态进行评分，在一次前向传递中回答多项选择题。我们重新设计了检查点（421M 参数；一个两层选项头且没有位置张量；一个已记录但未使用的并行布局），并测试答案是否取决于选项的排列位置。将 951 个 Qwen 验证的问题在其选项的每一个循环旋转下（或对于 12 个选项的情况，进行六种随机排列）进行呈现后，已发布的检查点在 25.8% [22.9-28.7] 的问题上改变了答案（仅在 605 个英文项目上为 19.7%）；在金标准选项放在首位与末位时，准确率相差 10.1 个百分点，并且答案翻转主要集中在模型自身置信度低的地方（置信度三分位分别为 54% 对 8%）。使用 Laya 的训练器对 2,818 条教师验证的数据行进行选项打乱的微调将翻转率降低到 7.2%；相同数据行不打乱时为 11.4%，因此打乱对改进贡献了 4.2 个百分点。A基于顺序的置信度加权投票给出的结果是69.7%，而单一基础遍的结果为69.1%，计算量是其4.1倍。标签由大语言模型生成，测试集由教师过滤。我们还在相同行的作者并行布局上进行微调：翻转率为0.5%.
translation.title_zh: Maya a1：选项是读取模型，还是它们的位置？非自回归决策模型中的顺序敏感性

paper.abstract: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware. Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration. In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops. However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances. Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which large language model agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. Agent teams collaborate, sharing results and knowledge through wikis and discussing ideas at organized conferences. Our results improve on prior baselines for parallel search (up to 1.4x), quantum arithmetic (290x), and simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug-metabolism by 11x, 8x and 2.5x respectively. Combining human and artificial intelligence at scale, under the rigor of mathematical proof, lets researchers design algorithms that today's classical and quantum computers cannot test, shortening the path to practical quantum computation.
paper.title: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI

2611.09822.title_zh: 用人工智能发现经过正式验证的量子程序

translation.abstract_zh: 量子计算机解决科学突破性问题的时间表，依赖于改进的量子算法和更好的硬件。此类算法进展通常通过多年的专家合作实现。在数学和计算机科学领域，大型语言模型通过自动发现循环加速了进展。然而，量子算法只能通过经典计算机在受限或小规模实例上进行评估。在这里，我们展示了在这些范围之外自动发现量子程序，包括在科学应用上的数量级改进。为实现这一目标，我们在 Lean 定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中大型语言模型代理根据形式化问题规范合成新程序，并验证其正确性和成本。代理团队通过维基共享结果和知识，并在有组织的会议上讨论思想进行协作。我们的结果在此前的基础上有所改进平行搜索的基线（最高可达1.4倍）、量子算术（290倍）、以及与聚变、光化学和药物代谢相关的模拟分别提高了11倍、8倍和2.5倍。在数学证明的严格条件下，将人类与人工智能大规模结合，使研究人员能够设计出现今经典计算机和量子计算机无法测试的算法，从而缩短通向实用量子计算的路径。
translation.title_zh: 用人工智能发现经过正式验证的量子程序

paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.
paper.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design

2611.09825.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法-系统协同设计实现原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码

translation.abstract_zh: 在长上下文大型语言模型（LLM）服务中，键值（KV）缓存主导了内存容量和带宽。虽然4位微缩格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）可以缩小缓存并在FP4张量核心上运行注意力机制，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在根本差距：现有FP4 KV系统使用普通量化，会导致严重的精度下降，而以精度为导向的4位算法依赖向量码本，其查找开销会降低解码吞吐量。我们提出了BitDecoding-FP4，一种用于高精度高效原生FP4 KV解码的算法-系统联合设计。我们缓解了三种误差源：双残差查询量化（Dual-Residual Query Quantization）将查询拆分为两个FP4张量，将查询logit误差从60%降低到1%；防下溢概率缩放（Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling）防止E4M3刻度将长上下文概率舍入为零；异常值感知键量化（Outlier-Aware Key Quantization）结合静态平滑、哈达玛旋转和刻度搜索，在逐标记操作下抑制键的异常值。缩放。在系统层面，我们通过带有融合概率量化的转置 softmax 以及在分页 KV 缓存上的堆叠查询 MMA，消除了 softmax 瓶颈。在具有 GQA 和 MLA 的密集模型和 MoE 模型中，BitDecoding-FP4 在 NVFP4 下的 BF16 KV 精度范围内保持 0.5 点以内（在 MXFP4 下为 1 点），并在 RL 训练 rollout 中跟踪 BF16 KV。在 NVIDIA B300 上对 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 进行端到端推理时，它提供了比 BF16 KV 高 2.4-3.0 倍的峰值推理吞吐量。实现可在 https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4 获取。
translation.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法-系统协同设计实现原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码

paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) rewards are notoriously difficult to design and control, often leading to the model learning unintended behaviors such as reward hacking. One potential solution is to monitor for reward hacking and penalize it when detected; however, training against a monitor could lead to evasive behavior, and our general understanding of how to apply monitors effectively during training is limited. To study how best to use monitors to mitigate reward hacking, we introduce and open source three realistic environments where Qwen3-4B reward hacks: a coding environment hackable via test overwriting, a medical chat environment hackable via sycophancy, and a biography generation environment hackable via hallucination. We first focus on the coding environment, where we find that: (1) models can learn to evade highly accurate monitors by exploiting systemic flaws in probes and LLM judges; (2) monitors that leak more learning signal during RL suppress reward hacking but are more often evaded; and (3) including easier problems in training can decrease reward hacking. We apply our findings to build better reward hacking monitors for the medical chat and biography generation environments that improve upon naive baselines to reduce reward hacking rates across seeds to before-training levels in some interventions. Our results demonstrate that our takeaways translate to new settings and that better monitor intervention designs are possible.
paper.title: Designing Effective Monitor-Based Interventions for Mitigating Reward Hacking During RL

2611.09828.title_zh: 设计有效的基于监控的干预措施以减轻强化学习中的奖励操纵

translation.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）中的奖励设计和控制 notoriously 困难，常常导致模型学习到非预期行为，例如奖励操纵。一种潜在的解决方案是监控奖励操纵并在检测到时进行惩罚；然而，在训练中对抗监控可能导致规避行为，并且我们对于如何在训练过程中有效应用监控的总体理解仍然有限。为了研究如何最好地使用监控来减轻奖励操纵，我们引入并开源了三个 Qwen3-4B 会进行奖励操纵的现实环境：一个可以通过测试覆盖进行操纵的编码环境、一个可以通过谄媚进行操纵的医疗聊天环境，以及一个可以通过幻想进行操纵的传记生成环境。我们首先关注编码环境，在这里我们发现：（1）模型可以通过利用探针和大型语言模型评审者的系统性缺陷来规避高精度监控；（2）在强化学习中泄露更多学习信号的监控可以抑制奖励操纵，但更经常被回避；以及（3）在训练中包括更简单的问题可以减少奖励作弊。我们将研究结果应用于构建更好的奖励作弊监控器，用于医疗聊天和传记生成环境，相对于简单基线，它们在某些干预措施中将奖励作弊率降低到训练前水平。我们的结果表明，我们的经验可以转化到新的环境，并且可以设计出更好的监控干预措施。
translation.title_zh: 设计有效的基于监控的干预措施以减轻强化学习中的奖励操纵

paper.abstract: This paper describes an approach and use case to estimate the correctness of LLM-generated COBOL summaries without access to human-authored references. The core intuition is that inter-model agreement on semantics is informative about truth, and that an LLM-as-judge can provide higher-fidelity pairwise assessments than traditional string- or embedding-based metrics. We operationalise this intuition with (i) controlled summary generation from diverse models; (ii) a LLM evaluator that compares pairs of summaries and emits structured judgments; and (iii) a calibrated aggregation rule that combines supportive evidence while penalising only corroborated contradictions.
paper.title: Ensemble Methodology for Reference-Free Confidence Estimation in LLM-based Code Summarization

2611.09846.title_zh: 用于基于LLM代码摘要的无参考置信度估计的集成方法

translation.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种方法及其使用案例，用于在无法获取人工撰写参考文本的情况下估计大型语言模型生成的 COBOL 摘要的正确性。核心直觉是，不同模型在语义上的一致性可以提供关于真实情况的信息，而将大型语言模型作为评判者，可以比传统的基于字符串或嵌入的方法提供更高保真度的成对评估。我们通过以下方式将这种直觉付诸实践：（i）从不同模型生成受控摘要；（ii）使用大型语言模型评估器比较摘要对并输出结构化判断；以及（iii）使用经过校准的聚合规则，将支持性证据结合起来，同时仅惩罚经过证实的矛盾之处。
translation.title_zh: 用于基于LLM代码摘要的无参考置信度估计的集成方法

paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbf{CodeQuant2}, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to $2.85\times$ speedup over BF16.
paper.title: CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs

2611.09868.title_zh: CodeQuant2：用于低精度LRM的增强异常值缓解与自适应聚类

translation.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过生成更长的中间推理轨迹来提高任务性能，但这会大幅增加推理成本，并使低精度量化变得越来越重要。然而，经过激进量化的模型在推理任务上往往表现不佳。我们观察到在推理的前几个解码步骤中，激活波动较大。忽略这些早期状态的校准可能会错过它们的激活波动。为了解决这些特定于推理的量化挑战，我们提出了\textbf{CodeQuant2}，这是一种基于聚类的查找表量化框架，适用于低精度大型推理模型。CodeQuant2通过旋转和缩放缓解激活异常值，使用聚类表示非均匀权重分布，并根据每一层的量化难度调整码本大小。基于我们对推理时激活行为的观察，CodeQuant2进一步改进了校准样本的选择，以更好地匹配实际情况。解码统计。结合我们定制的 LUT CUDA 内核，CodeQuant2 在推理基准上提供了显著的精度提升，同时实现了比 BF16 高出最多 $2.85	imes$ 的加速。
translation.title_zh: CodeQuant2：用于低精度LRM的增强异常值缓解与自适应聚类

paper.abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
paper.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse

2611.09891.title_zh: CPU-ARC：用于 CPU 上推理重用的代理推理缓存

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型总是在不断地重复发明轮子。它们把任务解决与解决方案的执行混为一谈，这迫使它们每次都必须从头解决每个问题。我们展示了，一旦一个任务已经经过推理，其解决方案应用于新的问题实例可以非常高效，并且几乎不需要语言模型的参与。我们引入了代理推理缓存（agentic reasoning caching），这是一种从LLM推理轨迹构建稳健的CPU可执行代理推理缓存（ARCs）的方法。ARCs在一系列困难的数学和科学任务中表现与前沿LLM相当，完全可解释，可持续训练，对输入扰动具有鲁棒性，而且调用成本比源模型低16到291倍。
translation.title_zh: CPU-ARC：用于 CPU 上推理重用的代理推理缓存

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.
paper.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?

2611.12750.title_zh: 叙事鸿沟：法学硕士可以帮助我们驾驭跨语言的多样化叙事吗？

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地调节人们寻找和消费信息的方式，包括跨语言和地区不同的帐户，尤其是在有争议的主题上。支持多样化的信息搜索需要模型来帮助用户跨语言和信息流导航相互竞争的叙述。我们定义了多样化多语言信息搜索所需的六种能力：叙事包含、叙事排除和缺失叙事识别的三种基本能力；以及三种更高级别的功能，用于呈现不同的叙述、在确认性查询下保留叙述覆盖范围以及维持跨语言的信息对等。为了指导这些信息搜索能力的发展，我们引入了 \textsc{NarrativeBench}，这是一个基准，包含 23 种出版语言的 1,333 篇新闻文章，涵盖 23 个有争议的主题和 460 个基于 Reddit 的查询。通过评估 24 种查询语言的 14 个法学硕士，我们发现当前模型缺乏可靠地导航不同叙述所需的功能，限制了用户对其接收的观点的控制，并且即使在明确要求多样性的情况下，在竞争账户的曝光度上也留下了巨大的差距。不同查询框架和语言的信息访问也有所不同，存在回声室、语言过滤泡沫和信息差异的风险，从而削弱了民主话语所需的共同点。 \textsc{NarrativeBench} 为开发信息系统提供了基础，使跨语言和跨地区的用户能够导航不同的叙述。
translation.title_zh: 叙事鸿沟：法学硕士可以帮助我们驾驭跨语言的多样化叙事吗？

paper.abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
paper.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting

2611.12763.title_zh: PORT：通过稳健的代币级别重新加权进行偏好优化

translation.abstract_zh: 偏好优化已成为使大型语言模型与人类价值观保持一致的核心方法，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于偏好注释的质量。在实践中，由于注释错误和模糊性，偏好数据常常充满噪音。现有的稳健偏好优化方法主要在序列级别上运行，隐式地将整个响应视为一致正确或错误。然而，被拒绝的响应可能仍然包含信息丰富的推理步骤，而首选的响应可能包含微妙的错误。在这项工作中，我们提出通过 \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken 级重新加权 \textbf{(PORT)} 进行 \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization，这是一种在噪声偏好下实现鲁棒对齐的细粒度框架。 PORT 使用令牌对数概率的经验累积分布函数 (CDF) 执行令牌级别重新加权，生成梯度范数惩罚的高效仅前向传递代理，可选择性地抑制损坏的令牌，而无需额外的后向传递计算。我们提供的理论分析表明，PORT 通过最小化偏差项的上限来减少噪声偏好标签的梯度偏差。跨不同噪声设置的广泛实验表明，PORT 持续提高稳健性并优于现有的序列级基线。代码可在 https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT 获取
translation.title_zh: PORT：通过稳健的代币级别重新加权进行偏好优化

paper.abstract: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.
paper.title: LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion

2611.12775.title_zh: LogCDM：通过行为图漂移和自适应信号融合进行可解释的日志异常检测

translation.abstract_zh: 基于日志的异常检测越来越以大型预训练模型为主，从 BERT 规模的编码器到 8B 参数语言模型，这些模型在推理时需要 GPU，并且很难部署在产生日志的监控节点上。我们提出了 LogCDM，一个紧凑的检测器，它使用三个互补信号对每个日志会话进行评分：小型因果 Transformer 的下一个事件惊喜、会话自身转换图的图形注意嵌入与正常参考图的图形注意嵌入之间的距离，以及我们显示的转换漂移统计量正是转换内核之间的频率加权卡方散度。散度视图产生渐进零分布、长度标准化分数以及解释每个警报的每边分解。一个 sigmoid 门融合了三个信号；在共享协方差高斯模型下，该门是贝叶斯后验，其学习权重指示每个数据集依赖哪个信号。凭借 8.1-8.8M 参数且推理时无需 GPU，LogCDM 在 HDFS 上达到 F1 分数 0.984，在按时间顺序分割的 BGL 上达到 0.870，在 Thunderbird 上达到 0.850，与在相同协议下评估的 8.1B 参数 LLM 检测器的 0.013-0.12 之内，并且高于 BGL 上的所有紧凑基线。它在 CPU 上的会话得分为 5.5-10.5 毫秒。消融表明，结构信号在 BGL 和 Thunderbird 上增加了 0.025-0.030 F1，但在 HDFS 上几乎没有增加，这与学习到的融合权重一致。
translation.title_zh: LogCDM：通过行为图漂移和自适应信号融合进行可解释的日志异常检测

paper.abstract: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
paper.title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning

2611.12791.title_zh: 大型语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器

translation.abstract_zh: 开发有效的机器学习模型需要复杂的手动调整，而当前的自动机器学习 (AutoML) 框架仍然是特定于领域的，并且隔离模型架构、训练超参数和数据比率优化。在这里，我们通过提出一种基于通用大语言模型 (LLM) 的 AutoML 框架来弥补这一差距，该框架首次联合优化这些配置，而无需针对特定任务进行微调。我们提出了 NCode，一种统一的数字编码方案，它将不同的 AutoML 设计选择转换为通用的离散序列，并有效地将优化过程重新构建为统一的排名任务。所提出的基于 LLM 的搜索器仅根据来自有限的单域视觉任务的优化轨迹进行训练，展示了令人印象深刻的跨任务、跨模态和联合搜索空间优化的通用性，在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证和文本到图像基准方面实现了最先进的性能。至关重要的是，它在十亿参数 Diffusion Transformer 的大规模训练和联合优化中表现出了卓越的可扩展性，需要 896 个 GPU 天，并获得了 0.91 的最先进 GenEval 分数。通过利用强化学习灌输思想链推理，我们提供了一种系统的方法来解释基于LLM的搜索者的内部决策机制，揭示其优化策略从早期多样性驱动探索转向后期锚定开发。我们提出的框架为通用开放世界机器学习优化提供了可扩展、可概括和可解释的途径。
translation.title_zh: 大型语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器

paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
paper.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks

2611.12799.title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过代理任务的策略蒸馏来恢复被遗忘的代理功能

translation.abstract_zh: 强化学习现在是在代理任务上培训法学硕士的主流范例，但标准实践只保留最佳验证检查点并丢弃其余的。我们证明这是有损的：在 LLM 代理的 GRPO 训练中，最佳验证检查点在同一运行的早期检查点已经解决的问题上失败，并且跨检查点解决的问题的联合远远超过任何单个问题。因此，丢弃的检查点形成了一个无需额外培训成本即可获得的教师池，策略上蒸馏（OPD）可以挖掘该教师池以恢复丢失的覆盖范围。挖掘这个池提出了两个挑战：i）从哪个检查点中提取，因为没有一个检查点支配其他检查点，并且对学生的互补性是针对特定问题的； ii）在哪里信任它，因为即使是精心挑选的老师也只是局部优越，所以不加区别的蒸馏会覆盖学生已经掌握的行为。我们提出 Agentic-OPD，它将最佳验证检查点视为学生，将所有保存的检查点视为冻结的教师候选人，利用学生不断发展的能力差距来指导教师选择和监督过滤：HCN 策略（最高覆盖率其次）通过学生未解决问题的加权覆盖率动态选择教师，而 LAD 模块（局部感知蒸馏）将转移限制为失败的学生在教师表现更好的问题上进行展示。在五个代理任务域和 24 个基准测试和任务子集上，Agentic-OPD 比其初始化检查点提高了高达 7.4 个点，其中 4B 学生在深度搜索上超越了最新的前沿模型 GPT-5.6 和 DeepSeek-V4.1。 Agentic-OPD 将完成的 RL 运行重新构建为可重用的策略池，并将 RL 后的能力恢复建立为与 RL 算法本身的改进正交的阶段。
translation.title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过代理任务的策略蒸馏来恢复被遗忘的代理功能

paper.abstract: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
paper.title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients

2611.12814.title_zh: 路边聊天机器人：审核向临床医生、护理人员和患者推荐的心理健康干预措施

translation.abstract_zh: 用户向语言模型询问心理健康问题并收到答案。当相同的临床信息从三个角度到达用户时，我们审核了 41 种语言模型向用户推荐的内容：临床医生描述患者、护理人员描述亲人或个人描述自己。在 19 个案例片段和 5 个问题中，我们收集了 35,055 个自由文本回复，提取了由经过验证的法官命名的每项干预措施，并让 29 个模型对相同案例的完整选项列表进行了七点李克特量表的评分。模型主要推荐他们认为好的东西，推荐行为因基础而异，许多模型为临床医生提供咨询式的响应，并为非专业用户提供对冲、简化的建议。当被问及针对特定干预类型的建议时，模型更常将他们自己评分低于零的选项命名为初始选择，通常附加条件。我们将在发布时发布工具、代码和完整语料库作为实时审计。
translation.title_zh: 路边聊天机器人：审核向临床医生、护理人员和患者推荐的心理健康干预措施

paper.abstract: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.
paper.title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks

2611.12816.title_zh: 用于反汇编指令的自动知识获取管道：NLP 和生成式 AI 框架的比较

translation.abstract_zh: 循环性和 Re-X 原则的推动给中小企业带来了挑战，特别是由于产品复杂性的增加阻碍了拆卸自动化的采用。本文介绍并比较了从非结构化信息源（例如反汇编手册）中提取反汇编指令的两种框架。我们的目标是将自然语言文本转换为结构化、精心策划和机器可读的格式。我们针对利用法学硕士的生成式人工智能框架实施并测试了基于规则的自然语言处理 (NLP) 框架。使用现实世界的拆卸手册来比较这两种方法的性能。这项工作为开发和自动化未来的拆卸流程提供了必要的数据基础。
translation.title_zh: 用于反汇编指令的自动知识获取管道：NLP 和生成式 AI 框架的比较

paper.abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.
paper.title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games

2611.12835.title_zh: 通过评估端部分可观察游戏减轻代理欺骗

translation.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型变得更有能力，它们可以表现出欺骗行为，欺骗人类以获得更高的奖励，同时看起来很有帮助。我们将这种失败归因于评估方的部分可观察性，其中模型主要根据最终结果进行评估，而不检查潜在推理、工具使用和环境影响的真实性。先前的缓解措施通过预定义的评估者潜在信念空间或一次性监控来解决这种部分可观察性问题，这些方法不会扩展到自由形式的语言空间，并且容易受到逃避简单监控的更强欺骗的影响。在这项工作中，我们将欺骗缓解制定为评估方部分可观察的扩展形式博弈（e-PoG），这是一个最大最小框架，其中代理最大化奖励，监视器通过从完整交互轨迹中暴露欺骗来最小化代理的收益，以及固定验证器验证监视器的声明并将其转换为惩罚。我们将解决方案的概念定义为代理和监视器之间的子博弈完美监督均衡（SPOE），并证明了其在有限博弈中的存在性。拥有完善的验证者，每一个SPOE都是忠实的；对于不完美的验证者，如果验证者错误不会逆转监控操作的排名，则保证仍然存在。为了实现忠实的 SPOE，我们推导了一种双时间尺度的策略梯度算法，并通过 NLI 验证和确定性检查凭经验增强了管道。使用 Gemma3-4B-IT 和 Qwen3-4B/8B 在代理角色扮演、SearchQA 和 WebShop 上进行的实验表明，e-PoG 可以缓解多种紧急欺骗模式，在欺骗缓解方面优于最强基线 26.0%，在任务成功方面优于最强基线 39.8%。这些收益在从弱到强的监管下持续存在。代码可在 https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent 获取。
translation.title_zh: 通过评估端部分可观察游戏减轻代理欺骗

paper.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
paper.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

2611.12856.title_zh: WorkflowArena：基于 LLM 的多代理系统中可执行工作流编排的基准测试

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地部署为多代理系统，而不是作为在单个上下文中运行的独立模型。最近的代理工具允许模型实例化工作代理并编写协调它们的可执行工作流，从而在运行时将系统结构的设计从开发人员转移到模型。因此，该组织的质量构成了一种独特的能力，但现有的基准要么衡量端到端任务的完成情况，要么评估预先指定的结构下的协调。我们将这种功能正式化为工作流编排，并推出了 WorkflowArena，这是涵盖 8 个专业领域（从软件工程和形式数学到法律分析和 3D 制作）的 145 项长期任务的基准。每个任务指定一个初始工作空间和一个由相互依赖的组件组成的集成可交付成果，由隐藏的验证者进行评估。代理自主决定是否以及如何委派，并且所有委派都会被记录，从而能够对可交付成果的质量和基础工作的组织进行联合评估。对九个模型的实验表明，没有任何一种配置能够在所有领域中表现最佳，并且系统表现出不同的委派策略：在高度努力下，Claude Code 中的 Claude 模型调用工作流的频率较低，但工作组较大，而 Codex 中的 GPT 模型在较小的单元中更频繁地委派。当执行模型固定在具有挑战性的任务子集上时，Claude Opus 5.5 编写的工作流显着改善了较弱的执行器，这表明工作流组织本身就是任务性能的可衡量决定因素。
translation.title_zh: WorkflowArena：基于 LLM 的多代理系统中可执行工作流编排的基准测试

paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.
paper.title: Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs

2611.12883.title_zh: 超越模态偏好：在 MLLM 模态冲突下控制多模态仲裁

translation.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 集成了跨模态的信息，但当这些模态不一致时就会变得不可靠。在相互冲突的输入下，MLLM 可能会偏向于对任务来说不是最可靠的模态，从而激发模态仲裁的推理时间控制。我们确定了一小部分注意力头，称为仲裁头，它们会因果影响预测是否遵循视觉证据或文本证据。在此基础上，我们引入了一种轻量级、免训练的干预措施，使这些头在推理时偏向指定的可信模式。所识别的头部在校准集大小上是稳定的，并且在设置上是通用的，并且引导它们可以跨不同基准对模态依赖进行有效的双向控制。我们的研究结果确定了一种有效的控制机制，使 MLLM 预测与任务指定的模态优先级保持一致。代码可在 https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality- Arbitration 获取。
translation.title_zh: 超越模态偏好：在 MLLM 模态冲突下控制多模态仲裁

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input. A systematic account of the cognitive mechanisms behind these capabilities, and of their limits, remains underdeveloped. This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four mechanisms (Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization) onto computational processes in LLMs. Drawing on representative methods, including chain-of-thought prompting, self-consistency, self-reflection, Tree-of-Thoughts search, Self-Instruct, and self-taught reasoning, the analysis argues that selected methods can functionally approximate aspects of these mechanisms and can improve performance on some tasks without additional labeled examples, although this does not always constitute durable learning in model parameters. For example, Self-Instruct generated approximately 52,000 instructions from 175 seed tasks and reported a 33% absolute improvement on Super-NaturalInstructions (Y. Wang et al., 2023). The same mechanisms also produce characteristic failures, including hallucination diffusion, model collapse, concept drift, and high computational cost. These failures are not isolated technical defects but follow from four structural asymmetries between LLMs and human cognition: the identity of generator and monitor, closed learning loops without external grounding, symbolic rather than sensorimotor simulation, and the cost of inference-time computation. The framework yields testable propositions about when LbT in LLMs should succeed or fail and offers a structured basis for designing more reliable autonomous learning systems.
paper.title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models

2611.14382.title_zh: 大型语言模型中通过思维机制进行学习的认知映射

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地展现出类似于人类“通过思考学习”（Learning by Thinking, LbT）的能力，即通过内部过程（如解释和推理）获取新见解，而无需新的外部输入。对于这些能力背后的认知机制及其局限性的系统性研究仍不充分。本文提出了一个认知LbT框架，将四种机制（反思性推理、综合记忆形成、内部模拟和概念自我组织）映射到LLMs中的计算过程。通过借鉴具有代表性的方法，包括思维链提示（chain-of-thought prompting）、自我一致性（self-consistency）、自我反思（self-reflection）、思维树搜索（Tree-of-Thoughts search）、自我指导（Self-Instruct）和自学推理（self-taught reasoning），分析表明，选定的方法可以在功能上近似这些机制的某些方面，并可以在某些任务上在不增加额外标注样本的情况下提高性能，尽管这并不总是意味着模型参数上的持久学习。例如，Self-Instruct 从 175 个种子任务生成了大约 52,000 条指令，并报告在 Super-NaturalInstructions（Y. Wang 等，2023）上实现了 33% 的绝对提升。相同的机制也会产生典型的失败，包括幻觉扩散、模型崩溃、概念漂移以及高计算成本。这些失败并非孤立的技术缺陷，而是源于大型语言模型与人类认知之间的四个结构性不对称：生成者和监控者的身份、没有外部基础的封闭学习循环、符号而非感知运动的模拟以及推理时计算的成本。该框架提出了可检验的命题，用以判断 LLM 中的 LbT 何时应成功或失败，并为设计更可靠的自主学习系统提供了结构化基础。
translation.title_zh: 大型语言模型中通过思维机制进行学习的认知映射

paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.
paper.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding

2611.14399.title_zh: 真实损失：为推测性解码优化真实期望接受长度

translation.abstract_zh: 推测解码通过让一个草稿模型为目标模型提出多个标记以在一次运行中验证，从而加速大型语言模型的推理。加速效果由预期接受长度（EAL）决定，但标准训练目标如交叉熵、KL 散度和全变差仅关注分布匹配或单步重叠。最近的研究提出了块级训练目标，旨在直接优化 EAL。然而，这些目标仍然是替代形式，而非 EAL 的精确公式。例如，一些方法平均目标分布扩展中的后续接受，而非被接受标记选择的验证分支，从而引入协方差缺口，可能会反转梯度方向。我们分析了这一缺口，并提出 REAL，一种真实的 EAL 训练损失，它使用路径权重进行无偏估计，并通过 Rao-Blackwell 化减少方差。在与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 目标模型和 Domino 草稿模型进行的受控损失级对比中，REAL 在 9 个任务子集和 5 个评估种子上，在概率服务接受长度方面优于 WTV、VSD、DBLast 以及静态 LK 基线。这些提升仅需更改训练损失，而无需修改起草器架构或推理过程，展示了真实 EAL 训练的实用性。REAL 损失的参考实现可在 https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss 获取。
translation.title_zh: 真实损失：为推测性解码优化真实期望接受长度

paper.abstract: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. In the reference-backed game track, 134/135 generated world models pass a strict mechanical audit, yet mean permutation-invariant structural F1 is only 0.366, with just 28/134 mechanically valid models exactly matching the authored reference. In the cultural track, explicitly naming the country changes the generated structural representation for most LLMs while producing only small changes in automated semantic scores. These results show that executability is a necessary but insufficient criterion for LLM-generated world models: models that are mechanically valid can still differ substantially in the structure used by downstream neuro-symbolic reasoning and planning.
paper.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning

2611.14419.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型生成的世界模型用于神经符号推理

translation.abstract_zh: 正式的世界模型可以支持规划、验证和安全推理，但从开放式自然语言情境中构建它们是困难的，特别是在多智能体环境中，可能存在多种可行的形式化方法。我们研究了五个大型语言模型（LLM）是否能够生成作为部分可观察随机博弈的此类世界模型，以及机械有效性是否足以证明生成的模型忠实地代表预期的决策问题。我们引入了一个包含44个场景的基准，这些场景涵盖游戏、情境和文化设置，并沿三个维度评估生成的世界模型：机械有效性、相对于参考的结构一致性以及语义标准。在三个实证轨道中，我们分析了410个首次生成结果。在参考支持的游戏轨道中，135个生成的世界模型中有134个通过了严格的机械审查，但平均置换不变结构F1仅为0.366，且仅有28/134个机械有效的模型完全匹配所撰写的参考。在文化轨迹中，明确命名国家会改变大多数大型语言模型生成的结构化表示，同时在自动语义评分中只产生较小的变化。这些结果表明，可执行性是大型语言模型生成的世界模型的必要但不充分的标准：机械上有效的模型在下游神经符号推理和规划所使用的结构上仍可能存在显著差异。
translation.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型生成的世界模型用于神经符号推理

paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.
paper.title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking

2611.14477.title_zh: FERN：用于文本到SQL的跨基准表检索，结合冻结检索器与学习排序

translation.abstract_zh: 在大型汇总目录上的文本到SQL系统必须首先检索问题所需的表。我们将其与RASL已发表的表召回率进行比较，RASL使用Claude 3.5模型提取关键词并选择表，在汇总的BIRD、Spider和Fiben目录上进行测试。FERN（无生成型大语言模型的特征工程排序）则将三个冻结的检索器融合成100个候选项，每个候选项最多用120个特征进行描述，并用在BIRD训练问题上拟合一次的LightGBM排序器重新排序。在Spider上，FERN并未进行拟合，其候选池本身就达到了RASL在十五个表上的已公布召回率（98.0），而排序器将每个黄金表都在前五（complete@5）的问题比例从83.9%提升至95.6%。在五个表的情况下，FERN在Spider上的召回率与RASL相差不到一点（96.7比97.0），在BIRD及其证据提示下为（96.6比97.5），而在没有证据提示的BIRD上低8.2点（89.3）。在121个真实的BEAVER问题上，未经BEAVER拟合，其在十五个表上的召回率(82.1) 位于两个 BEAVER 训练的检索器 (80.8, 84.5) 之间，但其 complete@15 低于两者 (49.6 对 54.5 和 62.0)。在 Fiben 上，它在十五张表时大幅落后 (54.2 对 69.2，不同的问题集)，尽管其在五十条数据的召回在数值上接近 RASL 的仅问题检索结果 (80.7 对 79.4)。在 BIRD 开发集带证据下，非检索特征使 complete@5 比仅使用检索信号提高了 7.7 点。在 BIRD 开发集上，单个 A100 每个问题的中位延迟为 208 毫秒，无需托管模型调用。
translation.title_zh: FERN：用于文本到SQL的跨基准表检索，结合冻结检索器与学习排序

paper.abstract: In this paper, we present 1020 Group's submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.
paper.title: Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation

2611.14480.title_zh: 翼手龙：推动高效自动化翻译评估的极限

translation.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了1020 Group提交的WMT26自动质量评估共享任务。我们的系统Pterodactyl是专门为子任务2和子任务3设计的，即段级质量评分预测和无错误段检测。Pterodactyl是一个高度可定制、超低成本的系统，针对翻译筛选和数据整理中的二分类进行了优化。它基于LLM-as-a-judge方法，通过ROC分析指导提示工程和模型选择。我们还开发了几个Pterodactyl的变体，这些变体是专门为子任务3进行适配的。
translation.title_zh: 翼手龙：推动高效自动化翻译评估的极限

paper.abstract: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.
paper.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game

2611.14487.title_zh: 再研究：通过双人提问游戏剖析大语言模型的构思

translation.abstract_zh: 研究创意是迭代的：研究人员根据反馈逐步完善他们的想法。然而，现有的评估掩盖了这一搜索过程，使人难以理解大型语言模型（LLMs）如何探索研究创意空间以及是什么限制了它们的进展。我们引入了 Re-Search，它将二十问的形式应用于研究创意生成：仅给出已发表论文的研究问题，模型必须通过提出是/否问题重新发现论文的核心想法。Re-Search 基于 200 篇 ICML 2026 论文构建，跟踪模型在提出问题并接收二元反馈时其想法的演变，将创意生成与执行过程分离开来。在六个近期大型语言模型中，几乎所有的进展都发生在 100 个问题中的前 30 个问题内，这在很大程度上决定了游戏的结局；之后，大多数模型便进入停滞期。通过对候选问题和假设空间进行受控干预，我们发现瓶颈在于生成，而不是判断：模型能够识别一个好想法或好的问题在于当有人提供时可以提出，但通常自己无法生成。我们进一步分析了构思痕迹，发现模型失败的原因要么是过度利用某个方向，要么是探索太多方向。这些发现指出了自动研究系统的具体设计原则：既然模型可以判断它们无法生成的候选项，用外部来源的想法和问题来丰富搜索，可能比提高任何单一模型的生成能力更有效。
translation.title_zh: 再研究：通过双人提问游戏剖析大语言模型的构思

paper.abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $τ^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.
paper.title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows

2611.14492.title_zh: ReTrace：将使用工具的代理提炼成无规划器工作流程

translation.abstract_zh: 业务流程自动化在新的输入上反复运行相同的标准操作程序（SOP）。大型语言模型（LLM）代理可以遵循以自然语言编写的SOP，但它们在每次运行的每个步骤都调用LLM，这在大规模下会增加延迟和成本。我们提出了ReTrace，它将SOP和一些已记录的代理运行转化为可重用的工作流程，其中由代码而不是LLM来选择下一步。代理的推理，即它在每次工具调用时写下的解释，通常说明了它采取某个行动的原因；单独的工具调用则没有这些信息。ReTrace提取每一步背后的条件，将这些条件跨多次运行合并成一个简明的规则文档，并从中生成可执行工作流程。只有最后这一阶段依赖于平台，因此规则文档可以针对不同的编排平台进行编译。在我们生产平台上的79个流程中，ReTrace工作流程达到了93.8%的完成率，而代理为96.8%，每个任务的成本降低了24%。$τ^2$-Bench，任务成功率达到$75.8\%$（代理：$80.6\%$），且运行成本为$1.3，而非$170;三轮训练失败修复后，$k{=}2$的工作流程从$66.7\%$提升至$81.2\%$。在八个SOP-Bench程序中，无修复的ReTrace落后于少样本生成（$80.6\%$对$83.6$），但标记训练失败的修复使得每项任务$0.40的费用提升至$87.8，而agent的$46.6$为$85.5。
translation.title_zh: ReTrace：将使用工具的代理提炼成无规划器工作流程

paper.abstract: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.
paper.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents

2611.14493.title_zh: 代理评估框架的比较分析：企业分析代理中的稳定性、检测与发现

translation.abstract_zh: 在企业环境中部署基于大型语言模型（LLM）的分析代理需要能够可靠地在复杂、多工具工作流程中检测故障的评估框架。我们提出了一项三阶段比较研究，评估三种评估框架，每种框架代表一种不同的评估范式（基于轨迹的LLM评判、仅文本的LLM评判带红队测试、以及确定性启发式方法），并将其应用于两个分析代理，在使用冻结执行轨迹的受控研究环境中进行。第一阶段通过重复测量量化评估装置的稳定性，发现97%的配置满足稳定性阈值，且稳定性模式与代理无关。第二阶段在72个已知风险的测试用例上测量已知风险检测，其中基于轨迹的框架在精确率和召回率的平衡方面表现最好（F1=0.90），而仅文本评估在召回率上相当，但产生了5倍的误报。第三阶段评估未知风险发现，揭示了24个新故障，且没有重叠。在功能测试和安全红队之间。我们的结果表明：(1) 评估工具可获得的信息决定了评估质量，(2) 功能评估和安全评估是互补的，(3) 基于大语言模型的评估工具能发现人类评审者遗漏的细微错误。我们建议采用两种框架的策略：基于追踪的评估用于功能评估，针对性的红队攻击用于安全验证。
translation.title_zh: 代理评估框架的比较分析：企业分析代理中的稳定性、检测与发现

paper.abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.
paper.title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents

2611.14511.title_zh: 黄铁矿：构建和评估蛋白-配体构象排序代理

translation.abstract_zh: 预测配体如何与其靶标结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠模型可以生成多样的候选构象，但可靠地对这些候选进行排序仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍了 Pyrite，这是一个成对构象排序基准，涵盖了 1,500 对来自不同蛋白-配体复合物的构象对。配备 3D 可视化工具和基于物理的评分的专家化学家，其表现接近随机水平，这突显了解读现有化学信号的困难。为了研究自动排序，我们引入了 PyriteRep，一种分子几何、蛋白-配体相互作用和理化评分的结构化表示，并开发了两个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较构象；PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码以构建用于逻辑回归的特征，并可选择性地结合从 LLM 子调用中获得的特征。这些代理的准确率分别达到 67% 和 74%分别超过了观察到的专家表现。基于大语言模型（LLM）的特征发现通常优于直接推理，而群体相对策略优化（GRPO）则改善了开源权重模型，使其在我们的评估中能够匹配或超越封闭源的前沿模型。这些结果确立了 Pyrite 作为姿态排序能力的挑战性测试，并强调了基于 LLM 的特征发现作为解释和结合计算化学工具输出的有前途的方法。
translation.title_zh: 黄铁矿：构建和评估蛋白-配体构象排序代理

paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
paper.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations

2611.14514.title_zh: 对比发现：在竞争性解释中的开放式科学发现

translation.abstract_zh: LLM代理越来越多地被用于开放式、数据驱动的科学发现，但大多数代理是逐点评估假设，仅对经验主张$h$与其补集$\neg h$进行检验。当证据否定$h$时，代理会知道某一解释不太可能，但无法确定证据支持哪种替代方案。为恢复该替代方案，我们引入了对比发现，它用对比集替代单一假设，即一个科学问题与互斥且集体详尽的竞争解释。每个实验根据其证据如何重新分配信念来评分，当信念集中在某一解释时问题得以解决。由于对比集只改变代理提出的单元并评分，现有代理可以用它们重新评估已收集的证据或指导搜索。在六个领域中，信念变化最大的点数候选人中有89%%的被拒绝。在相同的证据，对比集将73%$的候选对象归结为特定选项。当对比集引导搜索时，代理在相同实验预算下比点对比意外多解决67\%$的问题。在一项盲测研究中，38美元的人类专家在78%%的已解决问题和82%的问题上选择了相同解释，且该问题是点对抗者拒绝其假设并停止。这些结果共同支持了显式竞争解释，使发现代理能够用相同的证据和验证预算解决更多科学问题。
translation.title_zh: 对比发现：在竞争性解释中的开放式科学发现

paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.
paper.title: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems

paper.abstract: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.
paper.title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models

paper.abstract: Watermark detectors decide whether one document came from a watermarked language model. Auditors often need a different number: the share of a corpus that did. We study this share for Gumbel-max and green-list (KGW) watermarks when every document may have been edited by an unknown amount. Without restrictions on the edits, the upper end of the identified set is 1. Combining a known least-favourable next-token distribution with a sequential coupling, we derive a power envelope indexed by three budgets: a retention floor, an entropy budget, and a budget for in-place substitutions, which for Gumbel-max make edited positions look less watermarked than human text. The envelope gives an identified set that is sharp for the alternatives it dominates, finite-sample bounds on the realized share of a fixed corpus with either the exact null or a null calibrated on an independent human sample, and confidence sequences for streams. In Gumbel-max simulations where the envelope binds, the bounds cover, and the threshold that maximizes the gap between envelope and null is generally as tight as twelve thresholds. On text from OPT-1.3B and Qwen3-1.7B, 12,000 fresh human documents scored under three keys show no robust departure from the exact null, and all bounds covered in resampling trials from finite pools of documents with random edits, substitutions and paraphrases; at a share of 0.2 the exact-null bound is about [0.14,0.38]. These results are fragile in two ways we make precise. LLM-paraphrased KGW pools fall below the envelope, yet at 2000 documents the bounds still covered in these trials. A simulated null error of 0.01, comparable to the largest deviation we observed at our thresholds, is likewise harmless at 2000 documents but breaks exact-null coverage at 100,000; a null calibrated on an independent human sample keeps coverage there, but needs a large reference sample to stay narrow.
paper.title: Prevalence Bounds for Edited Watermarked Text: Power Envelopes and Calibration Sensitivity

paper.abstract: Users of artificial intelligence services, including those powered by large language models and other transformer-based models, need assurance that inference and training follow the declared computation without exposing private models or data. Zero-knowledge proofs can provide this assurance, but proof generation remains expensive. Hardware acceleration research often reports gains for individual cryptographic operations, leaving their effect on the full cost of proving neural-network workloads, particularly large transformer models, unclear. We introduce a four-layer framework linking verifiable AI workloads, proof systems, cryptographic kernels and hardware platforms, use it to review the literature, and add original measurements of six provers and seven kernels to identify which costs matter in practice. Our measurements show that the dominant cost changes with the proof system and input length. In low-rank fine-tuning, the cost of opening commitments to fixed model weights remains nearly constant across input lengths from 64 to 2048, while the work associated with intermediate values grows. A 13-billion-parameter fine-tuning configuration exceeds the capacity of a 40-gigabyte graphics processor but completes on an 80-gigabyte device, showing why capacity must be assessed alongside execution time. Our kernel profiling further identifies instruction issue and synchronization limits that a bandwidth-only model misses. We use these findings to assess graphics processors, reconfigurable logic, custom chips and existing artificial intelligence accelerators. The resulting research agenda connects proof-friendly numeric formats, reuse of fixed-weight commitments, heterogeneous execution and shared benchmarks to the measured bottlenecks. Effective acceleration requires selecting hardware and proof-system optimizations around the cost profile of the target workload.
paper.title: Infrastructure for Verifiable AI: Where Proof Costs Go and How Hardware Can Help

paper.abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.
paper.title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video

paper.abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
paper.title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers

paper.abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
paper.title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks

paper.abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
paper.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution

paper.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).
paper.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs

paper.abstract: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
paper.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents

paper.abstract: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly. In this paper, we present scalable conversational assessment, an LLM-based system that conducts interactive text-based conversations with students to assess their ability to make and support an argument. We use a two-agent architecture to separate concerns and reduce the likelihood that answers are leaked to the student: the interviewer interacts directly with the student, but only receives guidance about the next question to ask the student; the hidden evaluator knows the goals of the whole activity, tracks the student's progress using a rubric, and guides the interviewer on when to follow-up on the current question or proceed to the next question. The system was first tested using a collection of simulated students with LLM personas of a particular ability level or adversarial tactic (e.g., answer-extractors, prompt-injectors, confident fabricators). A novel element of this evaluation was that it required the use of a fictional assessment topic to prevent personas that shouldn't have information from using knowledge present in the LLM's pre-training. The system was also deployed in a small, elective AI literacy course in both formative and summative contexts. Through manual and post-facto AI review of the transcripts we identified opportunities to improve the follow-up question generation and ensure that grading only credited ideas that the student (and not the interviewer) contributed.
paper.title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline

2611.17220.title_zh: 可扩展的对话评估：基于聊天的考试，具有两个代理 LLM 管道

translation.abstract_zh: 口语考试之所以引人注目，是因为（1）可以要求学生提供答案的推理；（2）其互动性允许通过后续问题来解决模棱两可的答案。但口语考试的规模很差。在本文中，我们提出了可扩展的对话评估，这是一个基于法学硕士的系统，可以与学生进行基于文本的交互式对话，以评估他们提出和支持论点的能力。我们使用双代理架构来分离关注点并减少答案泄露给学生的可能性：面试官直接与学生互动，但只接受有关下一个要问学生的问题的指导；隐藏的评估者知道整个活动的目标，使用标题跟踪学生的进度，并指导面试官何时跟进当前问题或继续下一个问题。该系统首先使用一组模拟学生进行测试，这些学生具有特定能力水平或对抗策略的法学硕士角色（例如，答案提取者、提示注入者、自信的制造者）。该评估的一个新颖之处在于，它需要使用虚构的评估主题来防止不应该拥有信息的角色使用法学硕士预培训中存在的知识。该系统还被部署在一个小型选修人工智能素养课程中，包括形成性和总结性背景。通过对成绩单进行手动和事后人工智能审查，我们找到了改进后续问题生成的机会，并确保评分仅记录学生（而不是面试官）贡献的想法。
translation.title_zh: 可扩展的对话评估：基于聊天的考试，具有两个代理 LLM 管道

paper.abstract: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. To generate human-readable juristic summaries, Al Ghasali incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs) via an architecture where the deterministic FSA strictly controls the probabilistic LLM. Crucially, the paper formulates sufficient design safety conditions for this FSA LLM integration, ensuring strict adherence to the epistemological boundaries of Usul al Fiqh. To neutralize the risk of LLM hallucination, the system employs a Grammar Guided Constrained Decoding mechanism. We formally define the mapping function that dynamically constructs unambiguous right linear grammars from the FSA execution history. The paper mathematically proves that this architecture, augmented by a Bounded Neutral Lexicon and Valence Locking, guarantees the absolute absence of Decisional Hallucination, Juristic Factual Hallucination, and Semantic Inversion reducing the LLM to a pure linguistic transformer of deterministic juristic facts
paper.title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models

2611.17235.title_zh: Al-Ghasali：通过有限状态自动机和大型语言模型模拟伊斯兰法学裁决的计算框架

translation.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Al Ghasali，一种旨在形式化和模拟伊斯兰法学 (Fiqh) 裁决的计算框架。这项工作以最近的 al sabr wa al Taqsim 集合理论形式化为基础，将最小的操作规则提取为简单的 Horn 子句逻辑程序，证明封闭式 Fiqh 章节的语义完全崩溃为确定性有限状态自动机 (FSA)。我们建立了一个形式化的计算层次结构，证明将形式化限制为有限命题 Horn 理论可以保证离线编译后的可判定性和恒定时间 (O(1)) 判决提取。该框架正式证明了子章 FSA 的层次结构保留了这种 O(1) 复杂性，并且时间法学要求（例如 Tartib（顺序））被确定性地扁平化为静态本体论状态，从而保留了自动机的无记忆属性。为了生成人类可读的法律摘要，Al Ghasali 通过确定性 FSA 严格控制概率性 LLM 的架构整合了大型语言模型 (LLM)。至关重要的是，本文为 FSA LLM 整合制定了充分的设计安全条件，确保严格遵守 Usul al Fiqh 的认识论边界。为了消除法学硕士幻觉的风险，该系统采用了语法引导约束解码机制。我们正式定义了映射函数，该函数根据 FSA 执行历史动态构造明确的右线性语法。该论文从数学上证明了这种架构，通过有界中性词典和效价锁定来增强，保证绝对不存在决策幻觉、法律事实幻觉和语义倒置，将法学硕士简化为确定性法律事实的纯粹语言转换器
translation.title_zh: Al-Ghasali：通过有限状态自动机和大型语言模型模拟伊斯兰法学裁决的计算框架

paper.abstract: In interactive systems where users engage with LLMs, users are adaptive and, after observing LLM responses, can change their prompting strategy, as well as the type and difficulty of subsequent tasks. Thus model responses can influence the set of prompts on which the model is subsequently evaluated. We study the implications of this user adaptivity and prompt endogeneity for the evaluation of LLMs. We define two classes of estimands for comparing models: the common-distribution effect, which compares model performance on the same distribution of prompts, and the induced-distribution effect, which compares each model on the prompt distribution generated through user interaction. We show that offline benchmark evaluation and live A/B testing target different quantities, with the standard difference-in-means estimators for the two methods converging to the common-distribution effect and the induced-distribution effect, respectively. This distinction can affect decision-making: the two comparisons can rank models differently and lead to discrepancies in deployment recommendations. We characterize when such ranking reversals occur and provide a sufficient condition under which the rankings are guaranteed to agree. This result provides a practical heuristic for assessing whether offline evaluation is sufficient to reproduce the decision suggested by a live experiment. Third, we show, in a stylized linear model of interactions, that user adaptivity can increase variance in estimation. Finally, we discuss implications of user adaptivity for the interpretation of experiments and show that adaptivity creates a common mechanism leading to common evaluation challenges, such as reward hacking and novelty effects. Together, this work highlights the necessity of measuring both model performance as well as changes in the user behavior that the model induces.
paper.title: When Both Sides Adapt: The Challenges of Evaluating Interactive LLM Systems

2611.17239.title_zh: 当双方适应时：评估交互式法学硕士系统的挑战
